2518-progress.name: Priestess A'moora
2518-progress.text:
I regret the task that I have asked you to carry out; but Lady Sathrah is beyond hope.

It is our hope to offer the sacrifice of the spinnerets to Elune. With this sacrifice, Elune will bless Sathrah so that she might be reborn, and at peace.
2518-progress.title: Tears of the Moon

2519-accept.name: Sister Aquinne
2519-accept.text:
A once great creature of the forest is in need of help, $r.

There is a difficult task that must be done.

Please seek out Priestess A'moora; she will explain things to you. Find her to the southeast of here, inside the Temple of the Moon.
2519-accept.title: The Temple of the Moon

2520-accept.name: Priestess A'moora
2520-accept.text:
Now you must finish the task to which you have been appointed. Take the spinnerets and offer Lady Sathrah's sacrifice to Elune; lay the great spider to rest.

Inside this temple, find the central fountain. There is where you may leave the sacrifice.  The holy waters will purify and cleanse the corruption that drove Sathrah mad.

When you have completed this, return to me.
2520-accept.title: Sathrah's Sacrifice

2541-accept.name: Oben Rageclaw
2541-accept.text:
The Gnarlpine shaman that inhabit this place have discovered a way of separating a sleeping druid's spirit from the physical body. The furbolg have animated my physical form and are using it to attack anyone that attempts to explore the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. I am now trapped in the Emerald Dream, powerless to stop this.

You must help me. The Gnarlpine shaman carry a strange charm which is used to perform this ritual, and I'd like to examine it. Please, $N, bring one to me.
2541-accept.title: The Sleeping Druid

2541-complete.name: Oben Rageclaw
2541-complete.text:
Thank you, $N.

What an odd trinket this is... I can sense the vile aura emanating from it; this is a very powerful enchantment.
2541-complete.title: The Sleeping Druid

2541-progress.name: Oben Rageclaw
2541-progress.text: If I can examine the charm, I may be able to figure out how to break the enchantment. Have you found one?
2541-progress.title: The Sleeping Druid

256-progress.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
256-progress.text: Yes? Is there something I can do for you?
256-progress.title: WANTED: Chok'sul

2561-accept.name: Oben Rageclaw
2561-accept.text:
After examining this charm, $N, I see now what must be done. Please take it, and do as I ask.

You are to explore the deepest areas of the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. There, you will find my soulless body... Although I regret what I am about to tell you, I see no other way to free myself from the control of the Gnarlpine.

In order for me to escape them, you must kill my physical form.  Once that is done, use the voodoo charm on my fallen body. After you have completed this task, please return to me.
2561-accept.title: Druid of the Claw

2561-complete.name: Oben Rageclaw
2561-complete.text:
I am finally free of the control of the Gnarlpine. Thank you, $N.

My spirit may now rest peacefully forever in the Emerald Dream.

Perhaps one day we may meet again, young $c. But, for now, please accept this reward as a symbol of my gratitude.
2561-complete.title: Druid of the Claw

264-accept.name: Clarice Foster
264-accept.text:
Filthy scum! Leaves me for his damn crusade. Because "the Light is the most important thing we have against the threats the undead pose."

Well, what about his children?! What about ME?! Night after night I sat patiently waiting for him... always second to his blasted duty!

Well, witness what "justice" brings you, $N! He's dead and I'm bearing the very thing he was trying to stop!

Take this piece of junk and put it on his tomb at the Sepulcher. I want nothing to do with it anymore... or him!
264-accept.title: Until Death Do Us Part

264-complete.name: Yuriv's Tombstone
264-complete.text:
You place the worthless pendant on the grave, and the gemstone within the setting seems to dull noticeably.

As you stand to leave, you look down at the pendant; it lies lifelessly over the hands of the relief sculpted into the top of the coffin. Your thoughts are interrupted by a stiff, cool breeze passing over the Sepulcher. For a moment everything around you is silent.
264-complete.title: Until Death Do Us Part

264-progress.name: Yuriv's Tombstone
264-progress.text:
The stone is cold to the touch,  but has obviously been abused. Trash litters the area; nicks and gashes decorate the relief atop the coffin; and the foliage around the grave has started to grow over the site.

No one cares for whoever is buried here, especially not any victims of the plague.
264-progress.title: Until Death Do Us Part

267-accept.name: Captain Rugelfuss
267-accept.text:
$C, you may or may not be aware of the Trogg threat looming over Dwarven lands.  With the Ironforge Reserve called up to the Alliance Front, we are left with a fraction of the defense forces needed to keep these lands safe.  My regiment is assigned to watch over the Gate here and we cannot leave our post for fear of invasion.

But we need some pressure put on those damned Troggs lurking in the hills.  If you're up to the task, wage an assault on the Troggs.  Bring me back 8 Trogg Stone Teeth as proof.
267-accept.title: The Trogg Threat

267-complete.name: Captain Rugelfuss
267-complete.text: I am quite impressed, $N.  You have done the Dwarven race a great favor by defending our lands.  King Magni Bronzebeard himself would be proud!
267-complete.title: The Trogg Threat

267-progress.name: Captain Rugelfuss
267-progress.text: Do you have 8 Trogg Stone Teeth to show me?  If not, there is still work to be done, $N.
267-progress.title: The Trogg Threat

27-accept.name: Turak Runetotem
27-accept.text:
$N, I have been following your progress with much delight.  You are most assuredly developing yourself into a valued protector of nature.

The time has come for you to learn more about one of the various animal aspects that Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to change into - one that affords you command and mastery of the water.  For this, you must travel to the village of Nighthaven in Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze of the Cenarion Circle there.  He will guide you further.
27-accept.title: A Lesson to Learn

282-accept.name: Grelin Whitebeard
282-accept.text:
I was planning on sending my apprentice to my brother Senir with my report, but I would feel much better were it placed in more... reliable hands. That is, of course, if you wouldn't mind?

Hmm... you'll have to take the tunnel to get to Kharanos.

Speak with Mountaineer Thalos before going through the tunnel. It's completely infested with troggs now.

Follow the road back to Anvilmar, then keep heading east to the tunnel, Thalos is stationed nearby.
282-accept.title: Senir's Observations

282-complete.name: Mountaineer Thalos
282-complete.text:
Hm, well, if Whitebeard is sending you to Dun Morogh on important business, I can't very well stop you, can I?

At least let me provide you with some advice and directions.
282-complete.title: Senir's Observations

282-progress.name: Mountaineer Thalos
282-progress.text:
Hail! Have a care, $N, the tunnel to Dun Morogh is infested with troggs and is not safe for travel.

If you haven't any pressing business in Dun Morogh, I'll have to ask you to remain in Anvilmar until the tunnel is safer.
282-progress.title: Senir's Observations

2842-accept.name: Sovik
2842-accept.text:
As soon as we got word from Kernobee about the new gnomish rig, Scooty and I began work on the Transpolyporter 6000: The fastest and most reliable way to Gnomeregan.

It's finally ready for passengers to board, $N. If you want to give it a try, go to Booty Bay and talk with Scooty at the wind rider roost. To get to Booty Bay, take the boat from Ratchet.

Of course, you could always try and make the run to Gnomeregan through the dwarf infested mountains of Dun Morogh!
2842-accept.title: Chief Engineer Scooty

287-progress.name: Senir Whitebeard
287-progress.text: You can't find it? My directions were very clear! We don't have much time, you've got to hurry! Don't come back until you've found the cave.
287-progress.title: Frostmane Hold

291-progress.name: Senator Barin Redstone
291-progress.text: Hmm... it would seem that my guards are becoming less discriminatory with petitioners. Well, what do you want? Make it quick.
291-progress.title: The Reports

297-progress.name: Magmar Fellhew
297-progress.text: Do you have those Idols?  We must study them and report our findings to Ironforge!
297-progress.title: Gathering Idols

298-progress.name: Jern Hornhelm
298-progress.text: Oh, a progress report from the site?  Very good!
298-progress.title: Excavation Progress Report

2983-accept.name: Swart
2983-accept.text:
It's been some time since you were tested last, $N. You've been patient thus far in your studies, but it's time for you to learn about greater powers... it's time you learn real power. The element of fire is yours if you're prepared to pay for it.

Seek out Kranal Fiss in the Barrens. He lives in a small dwelling north of the Crossroads, but be mindful, if you've reached the blasted night elf lands, you've gone way too far.
2983-accept.title: Call of Fire

2983-complete.name: Kranal Fiss
2983-complete.text:
Hmmm, Swart sent you to me, did he?

Well then, Swart could always be trusted, so that must mean you're ready to take part of the next sapta--the sapta of fire.

I see it in your eyes already, the burning, the desire. You've tasted power, and now you're ready for more of it. Patience, $N. Remember what earth taught you. Power and destruction will come easily, but you must still know when to stay your hand.
2983-complete.title: Call of Fire

301-progress.name: Prospector Stormpike
301-progress.text: We Stormpikes don't like being bothered with trivial matters, $c.  I hope you brought news worthy of my valuable attention.
301-progress.title: Report to Ironforge

307-accept.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-accept.text:
The Silver Stream Mine to the east ran dry long ago.  It was converted by the Miners' League into a storage depot, but now Kobolds have moved in, putting their filthy paws on good, Dwarven tools!

We'll root out those vermin soon enough, but the League wants someone to get their gear out of the mine before we warriors tromp in there and break things.  It'll be a tough delve - you might want cohorts at your side.

The gear is stored in Miners' League Crates throughout the mine.  Good luck.
307-accept.title: Filthy Paws

307-complete.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-complete.text: Did you see a lot of Kobolds in there?  I can't wait for the order to clear them out of the mine.  The thought of their grimy hands clawing around our mine makes my stomach rumble!
307-complete.title: Filthy Paws

307-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-progress.text: Do you have that Miners' Gear, $N?
307-progress.title: Filthy Paws

308-progress.name: Jarven Thunderbrew
308-progress.text: Hmph! There is all this booze down here, but I have strict orders not to touch it. If only I could get a taste of some of our Thunder Ale...that would sharpen my wits, no lying!
308-progress.title: Distracting Jarven

3084-accept.name: Gornek
3084-accept.text:
Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, $N.

Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the shaman trainer Shikrik. She would have words with you when you're ready.
3084-accept.title: Rune-Inscribed Tablet

3084-complete.name: Shikrik
3084-complete.text:
As you probably know, the elements give us our power. Fire, earth, water and air--these are our tools.

Our strength comes from the spirits of our ancestors. We are the leaders of our people. Like Thrall is to the Horde, so shall we be to the villages and towns we visit. They will look to us for wisdom and protection. To be better prepared, you must train often. When you feel you've gained more power, come to me and I shall teach you what I can.
3084-complete.title: Rune-Inscribed Tablet

3084-progress.name: Shikrik
3084-progress.text: Ah, welcome, $N. I'm pleased you have arrived. My days have become long and even busy what with so many students to teach, but the coming of one of your ilk brings me a great sense of accomplishment--I remember the days when I was taught by one of your shamans.
3084-progress.title: Rune-Inscribed Tablet

3094-progress.name: Gart Mistrunner
3094-progress.text: You have arrived. This is good. Our ancestors' spirits have become restless throughout Mulgore and beyond, but I cannot tell why. It will forever be your duty to learn to listen to nature's spirits, and act as their avatar. Be mindful of that.
3094-progress.title: Verdant Note

3098-progress.name: Isabella
3098-progress.text: I knew you would come to me, $N. Not because you do not have the will to follow your own path, but because we are kindred spirits. We both have felt pain. We have both suffered. And now we want the power to take back what we know is ours: this land, our lives, our destinies. But there is much for you to learn still.
3098-progress.title: Glyphic Scroll

310-progress.name: Unguarded Thunder Ale Barrel
310-progress.text: The date on this barrel shows that it'll soon be tapped.
310-progress.title: Bitter Rivals

3100-accept.name: Marshal McBride
3100-accept.text: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $N. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Llane, our local warrior trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
3100-accept.title: Simple Letter

3100-complete.name: Llane Beshere
3100-complete.text:
Get yourself squared away, learn the layout of the land, and come back to me whenever you need training. I'll be here night or day.

The Knights of the Silver Hand have done well in making this place fairly safe, but as you meet the other citizens, I think you'll find they all have problems they could use some help with--help a $c can give them. Good luck.
3100-complete.title: Simple Letter

3100-progress.name: Llane Beshere
3100-progress.text:
Ah, you got my letter, $N... good.

There's been an influx of warriors in Elwynn recently--which is good for Stormwind, but bad for the kobolds and Defias in the area.
3100-progress.title: Simple Letter

3105-progress.name: Drusilla La Salle
3105-progress.text: Ah, so you've arrived, and not a moment too soon, $N. Some of the guards were over here a moment ago and were giving me curious looks... pathetic mundanes.
3105-progress.title: Tainted Letter

3107-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
3107-accept.text: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the paladin trainer Bromos. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
3107-accept.title: Consecrated Rune

3107-complete.name: Bromos Grummner
3107-complete.text:
The humans have taught us a great deal about the Holy Light and how important their order is to them... and to protecting all of Azeroth. We have a great respect for how it is steeped in tradition, and how just one figure, one sacrifice, can make the difference between pain and salvation.

The two of us are gonna be working together for a bit. Any time you think you're ready, come back to me and we'll see about getting you some training. Can't have you go out into the world unprepared, now, can we?
3107-complete.title: Consecrated Rune

3107-progress.name: Bromos Grummner
3107-progress.text:
So, you've made it! And not a second too soon. There's much to be done in Coldridge Valley and beyond. I'm gonna need your help as much as you're gonna need mine!

You're a Knight of the Silver Hand now, be ready to play the part.
3107-progress.title: Consecrated Rune

311-complete.name: Marleth Barleybrew
311-complete.text:
Not bad, $N! Did you have a hard time getting past their guard?

No matter--many thanks, and if you're ever in need of stout with a kick, don't forget the Barleybrews!
311-complete.title: Return to Marleth

3110-progress.name: Branstock Khalder
3110-progress.text:
Ach! Ya made it, $N! Wonderful!

I was gonna say, I was about to lose faith that ye'd arrive at all... get it, lose faith? It's a joke, lad... aww, nevermind. Ya didn't come here for me bad jokes anyway.
3110-progress.title: Hallowed Rune

3114-progress.name: Marryk Nurribit
3114-progress.text: Yeah, what's that, $r? Speak up, if you don't mind. I don't hear so good after a few ales.
3114-progress.title: Glyphic Memorandum

3117-accept.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
3117-accept.text: This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our hunter trainer, Ayanna. It seems Ayanna would have words with you when you have a moment. Read it and bring it to her afterwards.
3117-accept.title: Etched Sigil

3117-complete.name: Ayanna Everstride
3117-complete.text:
As you experience what Shadowglen has to teach you, come see me--I will be able to help you understand more about your role as a hunter and what you are capable of.

These are dangerous times, $N, do not take for granted the skill of your pets--there are things in this world more dangerous than you can imagine. Go with Elune and return to me again.
3117-complete.title: Etched Sigil

3117-progress.name: Ayanna Everstride
3117-progress.text:
You've arrived, and none too soon, $N. Welcome to Shadowglen.

I trust my sigil found you in good spirits and health?

As I said previously, I am here to train you as a hunter; to tame beasts to aid you in battle; to use a bow with unerring accuracy; to respect the lands which we call home and also the lands beyond.
3117-progress.title: Etched Sigil

312-complete.name: Tundra MacGrann
312-complete.text: What a kind soul you are, $N!  Thanks to your bravery I won't find myself starving when the cold season flurries blow in.
312-complete.title: Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash

312-progress.name: Tundra MacGrann
312-progress.text: Were you able to get into my meat locker, $N?
312-progress.title: Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash

3120-accept.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
3120-accept.text: This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our druid trainer, Mardant. It seems Mardant would have words with you when you have a moment. Read it and bring it to him afterwards.
3120-accept.title: Verdant Sigil

3120-complete.name: Mardant Strongoak
3120-complete.text:
I will be your mentor and guide for now. It is my duty to teach you how to interpret not only what the spirits communicate to us, but also the complexities and secrets of the Emerald Dream.

As you learn and grow in power, you will learn more of our sleeping trance. But until then, return to me as often as you like and I will teach you what I can in the ways of our kind.
3120-complete.title: Verdant Sigil

3120-progress.name: Mardant Strongoak
3120-progress.text:
Ah, young $c. I see you're eager to continue your studies. Good.

I wonder, have you spent much time in the Emerald Dream already? Perhaps you're not prepared for that yet... In time, I'm sure.

But until then, we should discuss other matters.
3120-progress.title: Verdant Sigil

313-progress.name: Pilot Stonegear
313-progress.text: Hey, $N.  Been to the Grizzled Den yet?  Those Wendigos can be fierce.
313-progress.title: The Grizzled Den

314-accept.name: Rudra Amberstill
314-accept.text:
We heard the cries in the middle of the night.  Then this morning, sure enough, the herd was missing two rams.  That dastardly beast known as Vagash has been preying on our livelihood.  With most of King Magni's army off in distant lands fighting with the Alliance, there is no one to keep Vagash at bay.

Perhaps you are brave enough to seek out the beast and slay him.  Bring me one of his fangs and I will reward you.  Vagash lurks just above the ranch here, but be warned, he is deadly.
314-accept.title: Protecting the Herd

314-complete.name: Rudra Amberstill
314-complete.text: Very well done!  Veron will be so happy when he hears the good news.  To kill Vagash is no easy task.  I imagine one day you'll be fighting alongside King Magni's men on the Alliance Front.
314-complete.title: Protecting the Herd

314-progress.name: Rudra Amberstill
314-progress.text: Vagash still terrorizes the herd!  Please help us by killing the wretched beast.
314-progress.title: Protecting the Herd

315-complete.name: Rejold Barleybrew
315-complete.text: Great!  I can't wait to use these in some of my recipes.  There's one in particular I think it'll work great in...
315-complete.title: The Perfect Stout

315-progress.name: Rejold Barleybrew
315-progress.text: Do you have that shimmerweed?  I almost have a batch of stout ready to brew, and I want to try throwing the weed in with this mixture.
315-progress.title: The Perfect Stout

317-progress.name: Pilot Bellowfiz
317-progress.text: Preparations are going well.  How goes your hunting?
317-progress.title: Stocking Jetsteam

3221-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
3221-accept.text: While you were out helping our deathstalkers, Apothecary Renferrel sent you a summons.  He did not give me details, but he wanted to speak with you about the wolf hearts you had given him.
3221-accept.title: Speak with Renferrel

3221-complete.name: Apothecary Renferrel
3221-complete.text: Ah, very good.  There is a matter regarding the wolf hearts you brought to me earlier that demands our attention.
3221-complete.title: Speak with Renferrel

3281-accept.name: Gazrog
3281-accept.text:
You may have killed the raptors, but the silver they stole must be recovered!  I have reports that the raptors have a large grouping of nests south of Ratchet, known as the Raptor Grounds.  It is likely that they brought our stolen silver there.

Go to this raptor haven and search for the stolen silver.  When you find it, return it to me.
3281-accept.title: Stolen Silver

3281-complete.name: Gazrog
3281-complete.text:
Aha!  So the raptors did hide the silver at their lair.  It's hard to believe these beasts would have the desire for silver.  Perhaps the stories of their intelligence are not as far from the mark as I thought!

Thank you, $N.  Take this as a reward for your service to us, and know that the guards of the crossroads owe their next month's pay to you.
3281-complete.title: Stolen Silver

33-accept.name: Eagan Peltskinner
33-accept.text:
I hate those nasty timber wolves!  But I sure like eating wolf steaks...  Bring me tough wolf meat and I will exchange it for something you'll find useful.

Tough wolf meat is gathered from hunting the timber wolves and young wolves wandering the Northshire countryside.
33-accept.title: Wolves Across the Border

33-complete.name: Eagan Peltskinner
33-complete.text:
You've been busy!  I can't wait to cook up that wolf meat...

I have some things here you might want - take your pick!
33-complete.title: Wolves Across the Border

33-progress.name: Eagan Peltskinner
33-progress.text: Hey $N.  I'm getting hungry...did you get that tough wolf meat?
33-progress.title: Wolves Across the Border

3301-accept.name: Tonga Runetotem
3301-accept.text:
My clanmate, Mura Runetotem, traveled to Silverpine so that she might aid our undead allies.  Silverpine is an ailing forest, a dying forest, and it was Mura's hope to bring it new life.  Perhaps the strange life found here in the Barrens can help her work in Silverpine.

Take a sample of the shells you gathered, and bring it to Mura in Silverpine.  She is staying at the Sepulcher.  With luck, studying the shell will give her the insight she needs to heal that dying place.
3301-accept.title: Mura Runetotem

3301-complete.name: Mura Runetotem
3301-complete.text:
Ah, what is this?  This shell has an inner glow, as if it still pulses with life.  Amazing!  I must study it further.

Thank you, $N.  With luck, this shell will hold a secret I can use to aid the poor land of Silverpine.
3301-complete.title: Mura Runetotem

3301-progress.name: Mura Runetotem
3301-progress.text: I can smell the dust of the Barrens on you, $c.  You have traveled far.
3301-progress.title: Mura Runetotem

332-progress.name: Suzetta Gallina
332-progress.text: Greetings and welcome, $gmaster:madam;.  Have you yet tried one of our fine wines?
332-progress.title: Wine Shop Advert

333-progress.name: Rema Schneider
333-progress.text: You bring word from Mr. Bagley?
333-progress.title: Harlan Needs a Resupply

334-progress.name: Thurman Schneider
334-progress.text: Are you here to buy clothes?
334-progress.title: Package for Thurman

3361-accept.name: Felix Whindlebolt
3361-accept.text:
We drove the troggs out of Gnomeregan, but then it all went so horribly wrong!  Now our home is completely irradiated, and we gnomes have been scattered all over Dun Morogh.

In my haste to get away from the radiation, I lost all my personal belongings and tools.  It was the trolls that got them.  They stole my chest, my box, and my bucket of bolts!  They took them back to their camps southwest of Anvilmar.

I'm no adventurer - could you find my things and bring them here to me, please?
3361-accept.title: A Refugee's Quandary

3361-complete.name: Felix Whindlebolt
3361-complete.text: Huzzah, you've found them!  You're an absolute savior, my friend.  Here, it's not much, but it's something for the trouble I've put you through!  Thank you!
3361-complete.title: A Refugee's Quandary

3361-progress.name: Felix Whindlebolt
3361-progress.text:
Oh goodness $N, this town is not well suited for the likes of me.  There are as many nasty creatures here as there were in Gnomeregan before the accident!

Do you have my belongings?  If you don't, then who knows what the trolls have done with them now...
3361-progress.title: A Refugee's Quandary

3364-accept.name: Nori Pridedrift
3364-accept.text:
Gah!  I was supposed to get this delicious scalding mornbrew to Durnan Furcutter inside Anvilmar a while ago now, but I had to deliver one to Grelin here first.  I'll never make it to Anvilmar before the brew runs cold!

You look fast.  Maybe you can make it.  This cup will only stay hot for five more minutes, and Durnan didn't order "chilly" mornbrew, so get going.  Anvilmar is to the northeast, a settlement dug into the mountain.

Thanks, $N, and don't forget to bring me back my mug!
3364-accept.title: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery

3364-complete.name: Durnan Furcutter
3364-complete.text: Ah good, now this will hit the spot.  Allow me to take a small break while I enjoy this scalding mornbrew!
3364-complete.title: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery

3364-progress.name: Durnan Furcutter
3364-progress.text: Aye, I'm Durnan Furcutter.  You have something for me?
3364-progress.title: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery

3365-accept.name: Durnan Furcutter
3365-accept.text:
Now that hit the spot!  Nothing like a piping hot - nay, SCALDING mornbrew on a cold winter's day to warm your cackles of yer soul.

Here ya go $N - be a pal and take this empty mug back to Nori for me, would ya now.
3365-accept.title: Bring Back the Mug

3365-complete.name: Nori Pridedrift
3365-complete.text:
Excellent, $N!  You'd be surprised how many couriers I meet who forget to do something as simple as bring back the mug.  Mugs don't grow on trees, or so they tell me!

Here's a little something for the effort.  Thanks again for your help.
3365-complete.title: Bring Back the Mug

3365-progress.name: Nori Pridedrift
3365-progress.text: I trust the scalding mornbrew got to Durnan on time!  Did you remember to bring me back my mug?
3365-progress.title: Bring Back the Mug

3369-accept.name: Falla Sagewind
3369-accept.text:
This shard holds great secrets; it is the pure essence of the Emerald Dream. However, what I see in this shard is not a dream; one would call this sort of a vision a nightmare.

I do not wish to alarm you, $N, but I think it is best if you deliver this shard into the hands of a wise druid as soon as you can.

Hamuul Runetotem on Elder Rise is who you need to find. Head to Thunder Bluff. I cannot say more.
3369-accept.title: In Nightmares

3369-complete.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
3369-complete.text:
Falla sent you to me? Well now, let's see that shard that you say she was so hesitant to talk about...

<Hamuul peers into the shard>

Oh... I didn't... Well.

$N, thank you for delivering this to me. It isn't wise to speak of things such as this, though, I advise you. These are matters that you should not concern yourself with.

Let's just say that things in the Emerald Dream are not as we thought...

Perhaps in the future, our paths may cross again.
3369-complete.title: In Nightmares

3369-progress.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
3369-progress.text: May I help you with something?
3369-progress.title: In Nightmares

3376-progress.name: Brave Windfeather
3376-progress.text:
Sharptusk will trouble us no more once you have brought me proof of his death.  It is his head that I seek, $N.

We tauren live for the hunt, and there is no greater hunt than against one that is cunning enough to perhaps hunt us back.  If you are successful in this task, young one, you will start to learn what I mean.
3376-progress.title: Break Sharptusk!

35-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
35-accept.text:
If you are concerned that the rumors of murlocs are true, then do this -- travel to the eastern Elwynn bridge and speak with Guard Thomas.  He has been stationed at the bridge for the past week and will know the state of the area.

Bring me his report.
35-accept.title: Further Concerns

35-complete.name: Guard Thomas
35-complete.text: Yes, murlocs have settled in and around the streams of eastern Elwynn.  We don't know why they are here, but they are aggressive and at least semi-intelligent.
35-complete.title: Further Concerns

3519-accept.name: Iverron
3519-accept.text:
Ughhh... I was bitten very badly by a spider named Githyiss the Vile while exploring the spider cave very close to here. I am sure I have been seriously poisoned; you must help me.

Please tell Dirania Silvershine. She will be able to help me.

Hurry... I'm so dizzy...
3519-accept.title: A Friend in Need

3519-complete.name: Dirania Silvershine
3519-complete.text: Oh dear; I was wondering why I hadn't seen Iverron yet today. And I've always warned him about those spiders...
3519-complete.title: A Friend in Need

3521-accept.name: Dirania Silvershine
3521-accept.text:
We may be able to help Iverron, as I know of an antidote that should help with the poison. It requires some ingredients, though, before I can make it.

I'll need Hyacinth mushrooms. You can find these growing under trees, or you may collect them from the grell south of here; they seem to have taken a liking to them. I'll also need Moonpetal lilies, which only grow around watery pools.

The last ingredient may prove the most difficult. From the very spiders that poisoned Iverron, collect Webwood ichor.
3521-accept.title: Iverron's Antidote

3521-complete.name: Dirania Silvershine
3521-complete.text:
Thank Elune that you have gathered these ingredients so quickly!

In just a moment, I will have the antidote prepared.
3521-complete.title: Iverron's Antidote

3521-progress.name: Dirania Silvershine
3521-progress.text: Please, collect the ingredients, $N. Iverron needs our help.
3521-progress.title: Iverron's Antidote

3522-accept.name: Dirania Silvershine
3522-accept.text:
The antidote is ready, $N. Please see that Iverron drinks it.

There is something that you should know -- the antidote -- it will only remain viable for 5 minutes. You must get it to him in time.

Speed be with you, $N.
3522-accept.title: Iverron's Antidote

3522-complete.name: Iverron
3522-complete.text:
What is this, $N?

Oh, I knew Dirania would be able to help me!

<Iverron drinks the antidote.>

I'm always getting into trouble and Dirania, well, she always manages to help me out of it.

I am feeling much better, but I think I will sit here for a while longer, until I feel completely better. Well, that, and I was hoping you'd clear a path for me through those vicious Webwood spiders...
3522-complete.title: Iverron's Antidote

3522-progress.name: Iverron
3522-progress.text: Oh... $N, I'm so glad you have returned.
3522-progress.title: Iverron's Antidote

3524-accept.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
3524-accept.text:
Majestic sea creatures are known to launch themselves at the Darkshore coastline, beached there until they die. Lately, these beasts have been washing ashore in ever-increasing numbers.  I've been sent here by the Temple of the Moon to investigate, but the presence of murlocs along the water has made my research difficult.

There is a giant creature washed ashore just south of Auberdine that is ringed by the foul Greymist murlocs.  Could you go there and retrieve bones from the creature for our study?
3524-accept.title: Washed Ashore

3524-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
3524-complete.text:
I hope the murloc did not give you much trouble in collecting this for us!  I will be sure to get this on the next hippogryph to Darnassus.  The Temple of the Moon has given me some funds to hand out for assistance; please have some with our thanks.

Your success here emboldens me to offer you a chance to aid the Temple of the Moon further, if you are interested...
3524-complete.title: Washed Ashore

3524-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
3524-progress.text: It is only recently that these creatures started landing on the coast of Darkshore in such alarming numbers.  I can't help but think that this is an ill omen of some sort.  Recovering a sample of that creature's bones to the south would help us in Darnassus assess this situation!
3524-progress.title: Washed Ashore

353-accept.name: Grimand Elmore
353-accept.text:
The Stormpikes are a respected dwarven clan, and are well known for their fine and discerning tastes.  So it's no wonder that Gringer Stormpike, a Mountaineer of Ironforge, commissioned me to craft him a weapon.

The weapon is finished, but... Mountaineer Stormpike is far away, in distant Loch Modan.  If you plan on traveling to the north, can you deliver this package to him?

My last message from Mountaineer Stormpike said he's stationed at the northern guard tower in Loch Modan.
353-accept.title: Stormpike's Delivery

353-complete.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-complete.text:
Aha!  So Grimand finally finished my axe!  I can't wait to try it against some troggs and kobolds!

Many thanks, $N.  It was a long distance to travel for this delivery.   Here are some coins for your efforts.
353-complete.title: Stormpike's Delivery

353-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-progress.text: You come all the way from Stormwind?  I hear it's getting dicey down there in the human lands, with brigands and orcs running about.  A perfect place for a $c to prove their worth!
353-progress.title: Stormpike's Delivery

354-progress.name: Coleman Farthing
354-progress.text: Do you have the remains of the Agamands?  Are those cursed beasts finally destroyed?
354-progress.title: Deaths in the Family

356-accept.name: Deathguard Linnea
356-accept.text:
The defenders on The Bulwark protecting Tirisfal from the Plaguelands are on constant alert. But sometimes Scourge will slip past them.

Our success at the Bulwark depends on a one-front battle - we cannot allow an attack from the rear, nor can we allow our defenders' supply line to be cut.

Assist the Bulwark. Patrol east and slay any Scourge you find. Spend particular effort at the Balnir Farmstead to the east. It has become a haven for interloping Scourge.
356-accept.title: Rear Guard Patrol

356-progress.name: Deathguard Linnea
356-progress.text: Do you have a report of your patrol?
356-progress.title: Rear Guard Patrol

357-complete.name: Bethor Iceshard
357-complete.text:
Very good, $N.  I will study this book and determine the identity of that lich.  You have served your Queen well.

<Bethor opens the book and stares intently at its glowing pages...>

Astonishing!  The book you retrieved belongs to no one other than Gunther Arcanus!

Gunther was a skilled Necromancer in life; he and I were friends and comrades-in-arms, before the Plague.  And judging from his book he has grown even more powerful in death.

His skills would be a great boon to us.
357-complete.title: The Lich's Identity

358-accept.name: Magistrate Sevren
358-accept.text:
The Mass Graves, southwest of Garren's Haunt to the north, were made to accommodate the...impressive...number of deaths Tirisfal suffered when the Plague first came.  

The bodies in these graves have so far been spared an undeath, but the Scourge now send Rot Hide Gnolls to gather the corpses and use them to bolster their armies.  This cannot be allowed!

Your task is twofold: slay the Rot Hides at the Mass Grave and Garren's Haunt, and gather from them the Embalming Ichor that gives them life.
358-accept.title: Graverobbers

358-progress.name: Magistrate Sevren
358-progress.text: Is your task complete?  Have you destroyed those dog-things and drained them of their ichor?
358-progress.title: Graverobbers

36-accept.name: Verna Furlbrow
36-accept.text:
I never thought the day would come when I'd leave the farm.  But the fields are overrun with thieves and it's far too dangerous for us here now.  As soon as Farmer Furlbrow gets the wagon fixed, we'll be on our way.  
 
Maybe you could do me a favor?  Let me scribble down my recipe for Westfall stew.  Please take it to Salma Saldean over on the farm yonder.  The Saldean's farm is just beyond the fork in the road.
36-accept.title: Westfall Stew

36-complete.name: Salma Saldean
36-complete.text: That Verna was always such a sweet lass.  We'll miss her here in Westfall but between you and me, she's a city girl at heart and Stormwind will suit her just fine.  But enough gossip!  Now we can make Westfall Stew!
36-complete.title: Westfall Stew

36-progress.name: Salma Saldean
36-progress.text: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much.  I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?
36-progress.title: Westfall Stew

365-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
365-progress.text: Deathguard Simmer sent word that you were going to provide me with some much needed reagents.  Were you able to gather 10 pumpkins yet, $N?
365-progress.title: Fields of Grief

366-progress.name: Gunther Arcanus
366-progress.text: Your masters are fools to send you here, for I will never again be a Scourge slave!
366-progress.title: Return the Book

367-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
367-progress.text: Have you collected 5 vials of darkhound blood yet, $N? Time is fleeting!
367-progress.title: A New Plague

368-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
368-progress.text: $N, were you able to obtain 5 Vile Fin Scales from the Murlocs?
368-progress.title: A New Plague

369-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
369-progress.text: Do you have some venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider yet, $N?  It's the final component I need in order to test my experiment.
369-progress.title: A New Plague

37-accept.name: Guard Thomas
37-accept.text:
A few days ago we sent two Guards, Rolf and Malakai, to investigate along the river, and they have not yet returned.  To complete my report, I must know what happened to those men.

Travel north along the river and find the guards... or their remains.
37-accept.title: Find the Lost Guards

37-complete.name: A half-eaten body
37-complete.text: Although much has been stripped from the corpse, strewn nearby is a medallion with the words: "Footman Malakai Stone" etched upon it.
37-complete.title: Find the Lost Guards

372-progress.name: Executor Zygand
372-progress.text: You have not yet performed your duty, $c.  We cannot expect to carry out The Dark Lady's plan with the Scarlet Crusade pestering our soldiers.  Bring about their deaths and perform your duty to Sylvanas!
372-progress.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

373-accept.name: Unknown
373-accept.text:
Searching Edwin VanCleef's person, you discover, among other things, an unsent letter. It is addressed to Baros Alexston, the City Architect of Stormwind, City Hall, Cathedral Square.

It appears to be recently written and sealed.
373-accept.title: The Unsent Letter

373-progress.name: Baros Alexston
373-progress.text: Yes? Is there something I can help you with?
373-progress.title: The Unsent Letter

374-progress.name: Deathguard Burgess
374-progress.text: Have you collected 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings yet, $c?
374-progress.title: Proof of Demise

375-progress.name: Gretchen Dedmar
375-progress.text: Do you have five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread yet, $N?
375-progress.title: The Chill of Death

376-progress.name: Novice Elreth
376-progress.text: Do try your best to keep yourself unharmed until I get you some armor.
376-progress.title: The Damned

38-accept.name: Salma Saldean
38-accept.text:
Help me make some Westfall Stew!  Come back with the following ingredients: 
 
 3 Stringy Vulture Meat 
 3 Goretusk Snouts 
 3 Murloc Eyes 
 3 Okra
38-accept.title: Westfall Stew

38-complete.name: Salma Saldean
38-complete.text: That Okra will thicken up this broth nicely!  Now we just add the Stringy Vulture Meat, a few Murloc Eyes and those delicious Goretusk Snouts.  And we're done!  For all your help, $N, I want you to take today's first batch of Westfall Stew!
38-complete.title: Westfall Stew

38-progress.name: Salma Saldean
38-progress.text:
Come back with the following ingredients: 
 
 3 Stringy Vulture Meat 
 3 Goretusk Snouts 
 3 Murloc Eyes 
 3 Okra
38-progress.title: Westfall Stew

381-progress.name: Executor Arren
381-progress.text: Those fools... They happily send themselves to their own graves.
381-progress.title: The Scarlet Crusade

384-progress.name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
384-progress.text: I'm going to need six crag boar ribs and a mug of Rhapsody Malt, $N.
384-progress.title: Beer Basted Boar Ribs

39-accept.name: Guard Thomas
39-accept.text:
Tell Marshal Dughan of Malakai and Rolf's deaths, and report to him that the Murlocs in eastern Elwynn cannot be contained by our current troop presence.

I know we don't have many troops to spare, but hopefully Dughan can find someone.
39-accept.title: Deliver Thomas' Report

39-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
39-complete.text:
Hmm, this news is troubling.  Already our defenses are stretched thin, and losing Rolf and Malakai to those murlocs put us in an even worse position.

If things don't improve, there will be fighting in Goldshire by the week's end!
39-complete.title: Deliver Thomas' Report

3902-progress.name: Deathguard Saltain
3902-progress.text: Have you managed to scavenge up some useful items for us?  There is no shame in reusing that which has been tossed aside.  No one is going to give us any handouts - we Forsaken will fend for ourselves!
3902-progress.title: Scavenging Deathknell

3903-accept.name: Deputy Willem
3903-accept.text:
You've shown yourself a dependable $c, $N.  Dependable, and not afraid to get your hands dirty, eh?

I have a friend, Milly Osworth, who's in some trouble.  She's over with her wagon on the other side of the abbey, near the stable.  I'm sure she could use a pair of hands like yours.
3903-accept.title: Milly Osworth

3903-complete.name: Milly Osworth
3903-complete.text:
Oh, Deputy Willem told you to speak with me?  He's a brave man and always willing to help, but his duties keep him stuck at Northshire Abbey and I'm afraid the problem I have today is beyond him.

Perhaps you can help me?
3903-complete.title: Milly Osworth

3904-accept.name: Milly Osworth
3904-accept.text:
A gang of brigands, the Defias, moved into the Northshire Vineyards while I was harvesting!  I reported it to the Northshire guards and they assured me they'd take care of things, but... I'm afraid for my crop of grapes!  If the Defias don't steal them then I fear our guards will trample them when they chase away the thugs.

Please, you must help me!  I gathered most of my grapes into buckets, but I left them in the vineyards to the southeast.

Bring me those crates!  Save my harvest!
3904-accept.title: Milly's Harvest

3904-complete.name: Milly Osworth
3904-complete.text:
Oh thank you, $N!  You saved my harvest!  And I hope you showed a few of those Defias that they can't cause trouble around here.

We might be short on guards these days, but we're lucky to have heroes like you to protect us!
3904-complete.title: Milly's Harvest

3905-accept.name: Milly Osworth
3905-accept.text:
Now that my crop is saved, take this Grape Manifest to Brother Neals.  He manages the store of food and drink in Northshire, and I'm sure he'll be delighted to hear that he has fresh grapes.

You'll find Brother Neals in the abbey, in the bell tower... where he likes to taste his wine.
3905-accept.title: Grape Manifest

3905-complete.name: Brother Neals
3905-complete.text:
Let's see here...

Oh my!  Milly's grapes have been saved!  When she told me that brigands overran her vineyards I nearly despaired, but my faith in the Light did not waver!

And through your bravery,  we now have grapes for more wine!  May the Light bless you, $N, and keep you safe!
3905-complete.title: Grape Manifest

3905-progress.name: Brother Neals
3905-progress.text: You look to be in fine spirits!  Come!  Have a seat, and have a drink!
3905-progress.title: Grape Manifest

3921-progress.name: Wenikee Boltbucket
3921-progress.text: I'm very busy with my work, $c.  Unless you have something for me, it'd be best if you moved along...
3921-progress.title: Wenikee Boltbucket

3924-complete.name: Rilli Greasygob
3924-complete.text:
You got the manual!  I can't wait to read it and find out how to fix the Samophlange!  I spoke with Sputtervalve in Ratchet--he wanted to thank you for your help, and wanted to reward your efforts.

I want to thank you too, and if I ever get this thing fixed I'll let you know...
3924-complete.title: Samophlange Manual

40-accept.name: Remy "Two Times"
40-accept.text:
$N, there's a new threat in Elwynn Forest!  Murlocs are swimming up the streams of eastern Elwynn, scaring away fish and attacking gentle folk!

I warned Marshal Dughan, but he's more worried about the gnolls and the bandits.  He's not convinced that the murlocs are a danger.

Please, $N, speak to Dughan and persuade him to send more troops to the east!
40-accept.title: A Fishy Peril

40-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
40-complete.text:
Yes, I spoke with Remy.  I respect him as a merchant, though all reports of Murlocs to the east have been sketchy at best.

Your concerns are noted, but unless I receive a military report of a murloc threat, we can't afford to send more troops east.
40-complete.title: A Fishy Peril

400-progress.name: Beldin Steelgrill
400-progress.text:
Hm?  You look a little young to be a siege engine pilot.  But no matter...do you need something fixed?

Well take a number and get comfortable.  I'm working on a couple engines right now and won't have time for another job for at least a few days.

Or, were you here for something else...?
400-progress.title: Tools for Steelgrill

404-progress.name: Deathguard Dillinger
404-progress.text: Have you completed the task with which I have charged you?  Do you have those putrid claws?
404-progress.title: A Putrid Task

405-progress.name: Bethor Iceshard
405-progress.text:
Greetings.  Either you do not know who I am, or your business with me is urgent.

Because if neither of these were true, then you would not be foolish enough to disturb me...
405-progress.title: The Prodigal Lich

407-progress.name: Captured Scarlet Zealot
407-progress.text:
Stay away, foul and unholy creature!  May the Light protect me!  The Scarlet Crusade shall rid Azeroth of your. . .

. . .oh wait.  Is that food for me?  I am so hungry. . .
407-progress.title: Fields of Grief

408-progress.name: Magistrate Sevren
408-progress.text: Time is not a luxury we have, $N.  With each passing hour, the Scourge's hold on Tirisfal Glades grows more firm.
408-progress.title: The Family Crypt

410-progress.name: Lillith's Dinner Table
410-progress.text: This is an old, beaten, bloody table.
410-progress.title: The Dormant Shade

411-progress.name: Bethor Iceshard
411-progress.text: Have you returned Gunther's book?  Has he responded?
411-progress.title: The Prodigal Lich Returns

412-progress.name: Razzle Sprysprocket
412-progress.text: The Recombobulator will be up and running as soon as we have sufficient Restabilization Cogs and Gyromechanic Gears.
412-progress.title: Operation Recombobulation

413-accept.name: Rejold Barleybrew
413-accept.text:
I'd like my brother Wellart to try my new Shimmer Stout.  He's a Mountaineer stationed in the southern guard tower, one of two towers on the border to Loch Modan.

He may not be a brewer like the rest of us Barleybrews, but he loves his drinks and I know he'll like this one.

Can you bring him this Barrel of Shimmer Stout for me?
413-accept.title: Shimmer Stout

413-complete.name: Mountaineer Barleybrew
413-complete.text:
<Mountaineer Barleybrew tastes the Shimmer Stout...>

Oh.  Whoa!  This stuff really puts a shine in your eyes.  I feel like I can see in the dark!
413-complete.title: Shimmer Stout

413-progress.name: Mountaineer Barleybrew
413-progress.text:
Hello, $C!  And what business takes you all the way out here?

Something exciting, I hope.  I haven't been in a good fight in days, and this barrel of ale is almost dry...
413-progress.title: Shimmer Stout

414-accept.name: Mountaineer Barleybrew
414-accept.text:
I've been drinking more of that Shimmer Stout my brother made - it's great stuff!  I want a fellow Mountaineer to try it.  His name's Kadrell, and he's usually patrolling the road through Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

To get to Thelsamar, go southeast through the tunnel, then turn northeast when the path forks into a road.  Follow that road straight into Thelsamar.

Give Mountaineer Kadrell this cask of Shimmer Stout and see what he thinks!
414-accept.title: Stout to Kadrell

414-complete.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
414-complete.text:
Now, let me have a taste...

Magni's Beard!  This stuff gets your head turning!  And it lightens the limbs, too.

I feel like I can fly!
414-complete.title: Stout to Kadrell

416-accept.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
416-accept.text:
We have a real infestation problem to the west.  Tunnel rat kobolds have moved into the foothills, setting up dens and fouling our land with their filth!

We want them eliminated.  Hunt them, bring me their ears and earn their bounty.

You can find tunnel rat kobolds and their dens west of Thelsamar, littered along the mountainside.
416-accept.title: Rat Catching

416-complete.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
416-complete.text:
Ugh!  When I asked for those ears I didn't realize they'd smell so bad!

Here's your reward, $N.  Well done.
416-complete.title: Rat Catching

416-progress.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
416-progress.text: Hail, $N.  How goes the rat catching?
416-progress.title: Rat Catching

4161-accept.name: Zarrin
4161-accept.text:
Long ago, the night elves were called the kaldorei, a name that means "children of the stars." Learning of the past is an important step in your path as a $c, $N, so listen well to what I have to tell you.

The kaldorei have always taken much pride in their harmonious relationship with nature. This means that we only take from nature what is necessary, and that we return in kind. This balance has afforded us much, $N.

Go out and collect seven small spider legs -- no more than that, and return to me.
4161-accept.title: Recipe of the Kaldorei

4161-complete.name: Zarrin
4161-complete.text: Always remember what I have shown you today, $N. You are part of the balance that the night elves strive to keep intact, even during troublesome times.
4161-complete.title: Recipe of the Kaldorei

4161-progress.name: Zarrin
4161-progress.text: Remember the balance, $N. I wish you to develop an understanding and a strong empathy for the living forests.
4161-progress.title: Recipe of the Kaldorei

417-accept.name: Unknown
417-accept.text:
Hildelve wrote in his journal that he was attacked by Mangeclaw, a "huge Ice Claw Bear."  He drove off the beast, but not before it mauled him savagely.

Judging from the state of Hildelve's body, Mangeclaw must have later returned and killed him.

However, Hildelve wrote in his journal his one, final wish:

Revenge against Mangeclaw.
417-accept.title: A Pilot's Revenge

417-complete.name: Pilot Hammerfoot
417-complete.text:
This is grim news, for Hildelve was a good friend.  And I wish I could have been there with you when you found the beast, Mangeclaw!

Thank you, $N.  Your deed will be remembered by the pilots of the Ironforge Siege Brigade.
417-complete.title: A Pilot's Revenge

417-progress.name: Pilot Hammerfoot
417-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Do you have word of my friend Hildelve?
417-progress.title: A Pilot's Revenge

418-accept.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-accept.text:
There's never a shortage of empty bellies here in Thelsamar, kids running in and out, workers from the excavation coming in after  a hard day's work. We're famous for our blood sausages, I don't suppose you've ever tried them?

No? Well, around here you've got to work for your meals, and don't think just because you're a fancy $c, you'll be any exception.

I'll need bear meat, boar intestines for the casings, and spider ichor for spice. You get me some of those, and leave the cooking to Vidra!
418-accept.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

418-complete.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-complete.text:
Trust me, it seems a lot harder than it looks, but...

Oh, I've never known someone to take much interest in the making of sausages, but I'll give you the recipe just in case. Here you go, mind you eat them fresh!
418-complete.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

418-progress.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-progress.text: I'm all ready to start cooking, do you have the ingredients for me?
418-progress.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

419-accept.name: Pilot Hammerfoot
419-accept.text:
My friend and fellow Siege Engine pilot, Mori Hildelve, is lost in the hills.  We were looking for a rare ore that's needed for a high-grade blastpowder, and during our search he drove his engine up a steep hill and busted it!

Still convinced that ore was in these mountains, Hildelve charged me to guard our engines while he continued on foot, searching.

It's been days, and I've heard some beastly growls in the hills at night.  Mori's tough as nails, but I'm worried.

Please, $N.  Find him.
419-accept.title: The Lost Pilot

419-complete.name: Unknown
419-complete.text:
Here is the corpse of a dwarf -- mauled, frozen, and picked clean by mountain scavengers.  Clutched in its hand is a book containing the roughly scribbled notes of Mori Hildelve.  And around its frame, still in superior condition, is a Brigadier's Vest.

This grisly scene must have been where the Siege Engine pilot met his end.
419-complete.title: The Lost Pilot

420-accept.name: Mountaineer Thalos
420-accept.text:
The troggs in the tunnel are extremely hostile, and haven't shown any hesitation in attacking travelers through the tunnel. You seem tough enough, though, so you should probably be safe.

Directions? If you're going to speak with Senir, you'll find him in Kharanos.

Make your way through the tunnel, and after you come out on the other side, just keep following the road, it'll run right into Kharanos.
420-accept.title: Senir's Observations

420-complete.name: Senir Whitebeard
420-complete.text:
What's this? Ah, my brother's report. Hmm...

I told him to be sparing with the use of the King's name, but he didn't listen. No harm, I suppose, though it's sure to ruffle some feathers in the Senate. Not that those weren't some feathers that needed ruffling! Hah!

Nonetheless, I guess that means that I should send my report on to Ironforge as well, but I must admit I'm a bit behind. Bloody cold.

I should have some work for you later, if you're interested.
420-complete.title: Senir's Observations

420-progress.name: Senir Whitebeard
420-progress.text: How are you? Like to share a drink with me, perhaps? Not much else to do in the cold.
420-progress.title: Senir's Observations

421-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
421-accept.text:
Lady Sylvanas has charged Varimathras with the conquering of the human and dwarven lands to the south.

But that fool, Arugal -- charlatan of Dalaran and now cursed beast of Shadowfang Keep -- let his reckless magic wreak havoc with the strategic stronghold of Silverpine Forest.

I need someone skilled in the ways of combat to help clean up Arugal's mess.  Prove yourself to me by killing 5 Moonrage Whitescalps.  The wretched beasts can often be found just off the road, down the hill below.
421-accept.title: Prove Your Worth

421-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
421-complete.text: You have served me well, $c.  It is obvious to me that you will be a worthy aide to me as I prepare to rid Silverpine Forest of Arugal's curse.
421-complete.title: Prove Your Worth

421-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
421-progress.text: If you wish to prove yourself to me, you must kill 5 Moonrage Whitescalps.  Accomplish that task, and I will see to it your skill is put to more worthy assignments.
421-progress.title: Prove Your Worth

422-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
422-accept.text:
How Arugal gained acceptance within the Kirin Tor is beyond me.  His spell-casting knowledge seemed as transparent as a blown glass bauble.

What's important now is learning exactly what magic Arugal used so that I can turn it against him and secure Silverpine Forest for the Dark Lady.

Arugal first stayed at the wheat farm just north of the bridge.  One of the Deathstalkers reported seeing some spellbooks but could not secure them.  Retrieve for me the spell labeled Remedy of Arugal from those books.
422-accept.title: Arugal's Folly

422-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
422-complete.text: This is precisely the spell I was in search of, $c.  If your dedication to The Dark Lady's cause remains infallible you will find you have quite a future amongst The Forsaken.
422-complete.title: Arugal's Folly

422-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
422-progress.text: Before I know what we are dealing with here, $c, I need to study the spell known as Remedy of Arugal.  Bring it to me now or I shall be forced to find myself a worthy servant.
422-progress.title: Arugal's Folly

423-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
423-accept.text:
After examining Arugal's work my worst suspicions were confirmed.  The old hack was not qualified to clean chamber pots in Dalaran let alone represent the Kirin Tor in its most dire hour.  Fools!

Arugal used enchanted items to reinforce his weak magic.  I need to examine these items first hand.  Travel forth and slay Moonrage Gluttons and Moonrage Darksouls until you have collected enough of their enchanted shackles for my research.  The foul creatures have been seen to the north and east.
423-accept.title: Arugal's Folly

423-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
423-progress.text: I will need 6 Glutton Shackles and 3 Darksoul Shackles before I can assess the situation and devise a final solution for Arugal.  Now heed your bidding and slay Moonrage Gluttons and Moonrage Darksouls until you have what I need.
423-progress.title: Arugal's Folly

424-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
424-progress.text: Has Grimson the Pale been slain?  Varimathras will not be pleased if we ignore his bidding.
424-progress.title: Arugal's Folly

425-progress.name: Rane Yorick
425-progress.text: Have you killed Ivar the Foul?  If you won't do it for me and my brother, then do it for the Forsaken.
425-progress.title: Ivar the Foul

426-progress.name: Deathguard Dillinger
426-progress.text: Our battles with the Scourge wage on, $N.  Do your part and throw those cursed, mindless undead back into the Plaguelands!
426-progress.title: The Mills Overrun

427-progress.name: Executor Zygand
427-progress.text: If you wish to prove your worth to The Dark Lady, slay 10 Scarlet Warriors, $c.
427-progress.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

429-accept.name: Rane Yorick
429-accept.text:
My brother Quinn was badly hurt by the ghoul, Ivar the Foul, and I don't know if he will heal properly without alchemical aid.  Although I am not an apothecary, I do know that our apothecaries can make healing potions from the discolored hearts of worgs.

Gather such hearts and take them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher to the south.  Then return here with the potion.

You can find plenty of worgs between here and Malden's Orchard to the east.
429-accept.title: Wild Hearts

429-complete.name: Apothecary Renferrel
429-complete.text:
<Renferrel takes the hearts.>

It is troubling to hear our Deathstalkers have failed their mission.

Let us hope that these failures are rare.

I'll give you the potion in a moment.
429-complete.title: Wild Hearts

429-progress.name: Apothecary Renferrel
429-progress.text: My time is short, $c, for the Dark Lady has charged me with a grave task.
429-progress.title: Wild Hearts

430-accept.name: Apothecary Renferrel
430-accept.text:
Here is the potion to aid in Quinn Yorick's recovery.

Now if you will excuse me, I have very important work to continue...
430-accept.title: Return to Quinn

430-complete.name: Quinn Yorick
430-complete.text:
<Quinn takes the potion and drinks it.>

<A few moments pass in suspenseful silence.>
430-complete.title: Return to Quinn

430-progress.name: Quinn Yorick
430-progress.text: My sister told me you were here to aid us.  Is that true?
430-progress.title: Return to Quinn

432-accept.name: Foreman Stonebrow
432-accept.text:
Those Light-blasted troggs, turning my work site into a wreck! Look at that, there goes another barrel of powder!

Ohhh, I wish I could go down there and wring every one of their scrawny little necks! I want to kill them all!

This can't be good for my health, all this stress and anger... What have they left me with? Nothing!

I'd kill them myself, but my aim's no good anymore! You go into the quarry and kill some of the filthy buggers! I'll pay you! Just hurt them, kill them!
432-accept.title: Those Blasted Troggs!

432-complete.name: Foreman Stonebrow
432-complete.text:
Well, that makes me feel a little better...

But I won't be happy until they're all dead! All of them!
432-complete.title: Those Blasted Troggs!

433-accept.name: Senator Mehr Stonehallow
433-accept.text:
As a member of the Senate and the Explorers' League, I've taken it upon myself to take care of this part of the trogg infestation that has gripped our lands.

They've certainly made a mess of Gol'Bolar quarry, and for no reason. As we dug deep into the earth, they poured out, destroying our equipment and driving the miners out. There's not much for us to do but to exterminate the lot of them, rebuild, then get back to work.

If you help me with the troggs, I'll gladly recompense you for your time.
433-accept.title: The Public Servant

433-complete.name: Senator Mehr Stonehallow
433-complete.text:
It is a start. Hopefully we can take advantage of it, and move some Mountaineers in to secure the area. Then we can begin to restore our infrastructure and get the miners back to work.

Thank you for your assistance, $N.
433-complete.title: The Public Servant

435-accept.name: Deathstalker Erland
435-accept.text:
The wolves outside won't leave, and they eye me evilly every time I step foot out that door.  They must be incredibly hungry to think I'm worth eating.

I have to report to my teammate, the Deathstalker Rane Yorick.  And to get to Rane, I'll need help against those wolves.

Please escort me!  And there are a lot of wolves out there, so we'll have a better chance if you have friends who can help...
435-accept.title: Escorting Erland

435-complete.name: Rane Yorick
435-complete.text: Thank you for the aid, $N.  I had feared Erland was overcome by the dangers of Silverpine.  With your help, I see that he has not.
435-complete.title: Escorting Erland

436-accept.name: Jern Hornhelm
436-accept.text:
Prospector Ironband is heading an excavation of ancient ruins east of the lake.  His progress has been slow lately, especially considering all the supplies we've sent him.

Ironband's a stout, honest dwarf who values results, which has me worried that forces are at work against him.

Go to Ironband's Excavation and speak with Magmar Fellhew.  He manages the details of the site and will know why there's a slowdown.

To get to the excavation site, go around the southern tip of the lake, then head east.
436-accept.title: Ironband's Excavation

437-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
437-accept.text:
Our initial scouting reports of Silverpine show the rot hides have a base at an old farm to the north, the Dead Fields.  We have sent small assaults against them, but each time they are reinforced by the banshee Nightlash, who uses her magic to rout our forces.

We want Nightlash destroyed.

Go to the Dead Fields and assault the rot hides.  If you don't see Nightlash then kill the rot hides until she appears, then defeat her.

Her essence will turn to dust.  Bring me that dust as proof.
437-accept.title: The Dead Fields

437-complete.name: High Executor Hadrec
437-complete.text:
I heard of your successful raid against the rot hides, $N, and this essence is proof of Nightlash's death.

The Scourge have lost ground this day.  Your value to the Forsaken grows.
437-complete.title: The Dead Fields

437-progress.name: High Executor Hadrec
437-progress.text: Have you defeated Nightlash, $N?  Our success against the rot hides depends on her destruction!
437-progress.title: The Dead Fields

438-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
438-accept.text:
$N, we've discovered a new hive for the Scourge: the Decrepit Ferry.  The ferry lies east of the Sepulcher, and is heavily patrolled by rot hides and other undead.

There must be a reason for the Scourge's occupation of the area.  Go to the Decrepit Ferry and find out why the Scourge are there.
438-accept.title: The Decrepit Ferry

438-complete.name: Corpse Laden Boat
438-complete.text:
Heaped within this boat is a pile of wrapped corpses.  And looking east across Lordamere Lake, an opposing dock on Fenris Isle can be seen.

The fate of the corpses must lie on Fenris Isle.
438-complete.title: The Decrepit Ferry

439-accept.name: Corpse Laden Boat
439-accept.text:
Among the corpses a hand protrudes, unwrapped.  It is the hand of a woman, pockmarked from the plague but relatively fresh.  

On the hand is a ring.  Removing the ring and inspecting it reveals an engraving:

"For Deliah"
439-accept.title: Rot Hide Clues

439-complete.name: High Executor Hadrec
439-complete.text:
You say that this ring was worn by a woman, recently killed?

The only nearby source of such a body would be the mass graves in Tirisfal.  The Rot Hide Gnolls must be taking those corpses to Fenris Isle!
439-complete.title: Rot Hide Clues

439-progress.name: High Executor Hadrec
439-progress.text: $N.  You return, so I assume your investigations bore fruit?
439-progress.title: Rot Hide Clues

440-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
440-accept.text:
If you want to find the husband or beloved who gave Deliah her ring... then speak with Magistrate Sevren in Brill.  He should have records of recent deaths and, with luck, can discover who Deliah is.

But I wouldn't hope.  Whoever gave her the ring is probably dead.  Or if he's undead he probably no longer cares about Deliah.
440-accept.title: The Engraved Ring

440-complete.name: Magistrate Sevren
440-complete.text:
A Deliah did live in Brill not long ago.  She was buried in the mass grave but if what you say is true, then the Rot Hide Gnolls must have stolen her body and taken it to Silverpine.

The Rot Hides, like all the Scourge, must be destroyed.  I trust you are taking steps to make that happen.
440-complete.title: The Engraved Ring

440-progress.name: Magistrate Sevren
440-progress.text: Hello, $N.  What brings you back to Brill?
440-progress.title: The Engraved Ring

4402-accept.name: Galgar
4402-accept.text:
It sure gets hot out here in the Valley of Trials.

<Galgar wipes his brow.>

If only I had some cactus apples, I could make my famous cactus apple surprise! Nothing cools you off faster than a piece of that delicious treat.

I'll tell you what, $N. If you bring me 10 cactus apples, I'll make you a few portions of cactus apple surprise to take with you on your adventures, and a free training manual, too. If you're interested, you can find cactus apples growing near the cactus plants around here.
4402-accept.title: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise

4402-complete.name: Galgar
4402-complete.text: Wonderful, $N! As promised, here is your cactus apple surprise. Pick one of these training manuals, too. I've got plenty to go around.
4402-complete.title: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise

4402-progress.name: Galgar
4402-progress.text: Have you finished collecting cactus apples?
4402-progress.title: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise

441-accept.name: Magistrate Sevren
441-accept.text:
Deliah had a husband, Raleigh, who now dwells in the Undercity.  If the Deliah who lived in Brill is the one who owned this ring, then Raleigh will know.

Raleigh is in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity.
441-accept.title: Raleigh and the Undercity

441-complete.name: Raleigh Andrean
441-complete.text:
Yes, this ring was my wife's.  Her fate was the fate of all who fail to endure these harsh times.  I feel nothing for her death, nor for the story you tell of her body's abduction.

Such feelings have long since grown cold within me.  But desire does still burn in my dead heart, $N.

Desire for revenge.
441-complete.title: Raleigh and the Undercity

443-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
443-accept.text:
Before we launch an assault on Fenris Isle, we must determine who is behind the rot hide gnolls.  Our apothecaries believe their origin lies within the strange fluid that flows through their bodies.

Go to Fenris Isle, east of the Decrepit Ferry, and collect rot hide ichor from the gnolls you find there.  Bring it to Apothecary Renferrel, stationed outside the Sepulcher.
443-accept.title: Rot Hide Ichor

443-progress.name: Apothecary Renferrel
443-progress.text: Do you have the rot hide ichor, $N?
443-progress.title: Rot Hide Ichor

444-progress.name: Bethor Iceshard
444-progress.text: My studies require great concentration.  So I hope your visit is not a frivolous one.
444-progress.title: Rot Hide Origins

446-progress.name: Apothecary Renferrel
446-progress.text: Greetings, $N.  What did Bethor have to say?
446-progress.title: Thule Ravenclaw

447-accept.name: Apothecary Renferrel
447-accept.text:
Arthas's numbers are overwhelming. But with a New Plague we could eradicate both the Scourge Army and the Human infestation once and for all.

My studies have proven that spider blood combined with a toxin derived from a grizzled bear heart results in a deadly elixir. Collect samples from the spiders in the Skittering Dark to the northwest and from the bears wandering throughout Silverpine Forest. Deliver the reagents to Master Apothecary Faranell of the Royal Apothecary Society in the Undercity.
447-accept.title: A Recipe For Death

447-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
447-progress.text: Hail, $c.  What business do you have with the Royal Apothecary Society?
447-progress.title: A Recipe For Death

449-accept.name: Rane Yorick
449-accept.text: Although Quinn's wounds are mending, I want to get our report to High Executor Hadrec as quickly as possible.  It has information that is vital to the Forsaken's occupation of Silverpine.
449-accept.title: The Deathstalkers' Report

449-complete.name: High Executor Hadrec
449-complete.text:
I hadn't accounted for the level of Scourge presence we've seen in Silverpine Forest, nor for the troubles our Deathstalkers have had in their scouting efforts.

Your aid to our Deathstalkers was invaluable, $N.  And you will be commended.
449-complete.title: The Deathstalkers' Report

449-progress.name: High Executor Hadrec
449-progress.text: Did you discover the fate of the Deathstalkers?
449-progress.title: The Deathstalkers' Report

4495-accept.name: Dirania Silvershine
4495-accept.text:
A friend of mine named Iverron usually visits me at the same time every day. The strange thing is that he hasn't been by today at all -- he's several hours late, in fact.

I admit, I am a little worried, $N. Iverron spends a lot of time over by the cave to the north, and I'm sure you know how dangerous it is there -- spiders, everywhere!

If you happen to be going that way, though, will you keep an eye out for him?
4495-accept.title: A Good Friend

4495-complete.name: Iverron
4495-complete.text: I'm so glad you found me, $N. How did you know I was here?
4495-complete.title: A Good Friend

45-accept.name: Unknown
45-accept.text:
Upon further searching the area, you find webbed footprints leading east along the shore of Stone Cairn Lake.  In the distance to the east, you can just barely see a Murloc village.

Perhaps Rolf's fate ended there...
45-accept.title: Discover Rolf's Fate

45-complete.name: Unknown
45-complete.text: You find around the neck of the corpse a metal medallion inscribed with the words "Footman Rolf Hartford."
45-complete.title: Discover Rolf's Fate

451-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
451-progress.text: What brings you back to the Undercity, $N?
451-progress.title: A Recipe For Death

456-accept.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
456-accept.text:
Greetings, $N.  I am Conservator Ilthalaine.  My purpose in Shadowglen is to ensure that the balance of nature is maintained.

The spring rains were particularly heavy this year, causing some of the forest's beasts to flourish while others suffered.

Unfortunately, the nightsaber and thistle boar populations grew too large.  Shadowglen can only produce so much food for the beasts.  Journey forth, young $c, and thin the boar and saber populations so that nature's harmony will be preserved.
456-accept.title: The Balance of Nature

457-accept.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
457-accept.text:
Thinning the younger population of creatures here in Shadowglen was a good start, $N, but there is still work to be done.

The resources of the forest will be depleted too quickly if the problem is not addressed.  Killing nature's beasts is a necessary evil for the good of all who share the land.  Venture into the forest and slay mangy nightsabers and thistle boars in the name of balance.
457-accept.title: The Balance of Nature

457-complete.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
457-complete.text: You have proven your dedication to nature well, $N.  A young $c like yourself has a promising future.
457-complete.title: The Balance of Nature

458-accept.name: Melithar Staghelm
458-accept.text:
Thank goodness you are here, $c. Strange news has traveled to me through the whisperings of the forest spirits.

The mysterious woodland protector, Tarindrella, has returned to Shadowglen. The dryad's presence has not been felt in the forests of Kalimdor in years. Something is surely amiss if she has journeyed back to this land.

Seek out Tarindrella and see what business she tends to in our grove. One of the Sentinels reported seeing her to the southwest of Aldrassil.
458-accept.title: The Woodland Protector

458-complete.name: Tarindrella
458-complete.text: I see you found me, young $r.  Melithar is a wise druid to have sent you. But you still have much to learn. I understand your kind enjoys books. Please take one of these to further your education.
458-complete.title: The Woodland Protector

459-accept.name: Tarindrella
459-accept.text:
Something evil is brewing in the forests of Teldrassil.  Look long the hills to where the peaceful furbolgs used to dwell.  They have deserted their homes and are amassing under the name of the Gnarlpine tribe.

Only the corruption of wicked Fel Moss could cause such a transformation.  The grells and grellkin have infested the area and are threatening the residents of Shadowglen.  

Engage these grells and grellkin, $N, and see if they are indeed caught under the enchantment of the wicked Fel Moss.
459-accept.title: The Woodland Protector

459-complete.name: Tarindrella
459-complete.text:
Your service to the creatures of Shadowglen is worthy of reward, $N.

You confirmed my fears, however.  If the grells have become tainted by the Fel Moss, one can only imagine what has become of the Gnarlpine tribe of furbolgs who once lived here.

Should you find yourself in Dolanaar, able $C, seek out the knowledgeable druid, Athridas Bearmantle.  He shares our concern for the well being of the forest.
459-complete.title: The Woodland Protector

459-progress.name: Tarindrella
459-progress.text: Satisfy my suspicions, $N.  Bring to me 8 Fel Moss.
459-progress.title: The Woodland Protector

46-accept.name: Guard Thomas
46-accept.text:
The Stormwind Army has placed a bounty on murloc lurkers and foragers in Elwynn.  Slaughter them and bring me their torn murloc fins, and the Stormwind Army will reward you well.

The murlocs have built a village at Stone Cairn Lake north of here, and another to the south where the stream forks.
46-accept.title: Bounty on Murlocs

46-complete.name: Guard Thomas
46-complete.text:
You have the fins?  Great!  Marshal Dughan is anxious about the Murloc situation in eastern Elwynn, and I'd like to tell him that it's becoming under control.

Your actions have helped realize that.
46-complete.title: Bounty on Murlocs

460-accept.name: Shallow Grave
460-accept.text:
You don't look like a rot hide.  Good.  I had lost hope...

My name is Alaric, and I was once Thule's head servant and bodyguard.  He used his magic to "protect" me from the Plague of Undeath, but instead his spell gave me an unlife from which I cannot escape.  And after creating the cursed rot hide gnolls, Thule beheaded me... and gave my head to the gnolls as a plaything!

Please, take me to my body.  I believe the gnolls buried it here in Fenris Keep, near the stable, in an unmarked grave.
460-accept.title: Resting in Pieces

461-progress.name: Dusty Shelf
461-progress.text: This is the spot!  Bring me closer...
461-progress.title: The Hidden Niche

4641-accept.name: Kaltunk
4641-accept.text:
Finally, you are of age, $N... of age to battle in the name of the Horde. To conquer for the glory of the Warchief.

Yes...

<Kaltunk looks you over.>

You will do nicely.

No doubt you wish to find a great dragon or demon and strangle it with your bare hands, but perhaps it would be wise to start on something less... dangerous.

<Kaltunk laughs.>

Report to Gornek, he should be able to assign a task better suited to a young $c. You will find Gornek in the Den, to the west.
4641-accept.title: Your Place in the World

4641-complete.name: Gornek
4641-complete.text:
Another one of Kaltunk's recruits, hm?

A sorry state of affairs we find ourselves in if this is the best the Horde can produce. No matter. By the time we think you're ready to leave the Valley, you'll be a proud warrior of the Horde.
4641-complete.title: Your Place in the World

4681-accept.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4681-accept.text:
That beached creature is not an isolated incident here in Darkshore.  There are more along the coastline and even in the water.  I would like for you to investigate another one that we know of; this one was reported to be in the water due west of Auberdine, close to a sunken vessel.  Return to me with anything that you may recover that would aid our research.

Also, in your travels you may find other creatures.  By all means, if you should discover anything then please bring it to our attention!
4681-accept.title: Washed Ashore

4681-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4681-progress.text: Once you have investigated the creature's remains in the water to the west of here, I should be able to file a proper report with the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
