I've been waiting forever for my last shipment of goods from Booty Bay! I'm pretty sure that it must have been stolen by the Freebooters, but just to make sure, will you go down to the dockside and ask Dizzywig if my goods were already put into my warehouse without my knowledge?

Here, take my ledger down to Dizzywig and have him double check my inventory records against his logs.
890-accept.title: The Missing Shipment

890-complete.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
890-complete.text:
Ah, Gazlowe sent you, did he? Just a moment, let me take a look here and check my own logs and make sure I didn't have Gazlowe's shipment sent to the wrong place.

Bet he's waiting for those boots from Drizzlek...
890-complete.title: The Missing Shipment

890-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
890-progress.text: Wares to send on the next ship, $N?
890-progress.title: The Missing Shipment

891-accept.name: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun
891-accept.text:
Yet another ship from my fleet has been lost to those overzealous humans at Northwatch Hold!

Those bastards must be dealt with. Their paranoia has them in a state of frenzy. Trigger happy, reckless louts are shooting at anything in their sights.

Travel south along the Merchant Coast to the Hold and lay siege to their forces. Bring me the medals of their soldiers as proof. And for the love of my fleet, slay Captain Fairmount and her overzealous cannoneers!
891-accept.title: The Guns of Northwatch

891-complete.name: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun
891-complete.text:
Alas, the righteous Alliance guns have been silenced. You shall be rewarded for your aid, $N.

Now to tend to the grim task of recovering the bodies of the dead....
891-complete.title: The Guns of Northwatch

891-progress.name: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun
891-progress.text: My fleet is in peril with Captain Fairmount and her damned cannoneers blasting away from Northwatch Hold. I want her soldiers to pay as well. Fill my hand with medals from their dead and I will know that vengeance has been given to my fallen privateers.
891-progress.title: The Guns of Northwatch

892-accept.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
892-accept.text:
Everything looks square from my records, $N. Go on back and tell Gazlowe he's out of luck. I wouldn't be surprised if it was the pirates that nabbed his goodies.

Nothing else I can do for him. Oh... though you could tell him that I've got some things from Undermine for him, when he has the time to come pick them up.
892-accept.title: The Missing Shipment

892-complete.name: Gazlowe
892-complete.text:
No dice, eh? I guess it must have been the Freebooters then... Dizzywig's on the level, I'm sure he wouldn't cheat me like that. After all, he is on the payroll.

Looks like I've got some goods to get back, $N. What do you say?
892-complete.title: The Missing Shipment

892-progress.name: Gazlowe
892-progress.text: So, what did Dizzywig have to say?
892-progress.title: The Missing Shipment

894-accept.name: Sputtervalve
894-accept.text:
The Venture Company set up a small research facility far to the north of here, southwest of the Sludge Fen. I don't know very much about what they're doing, but did manage to discover that they're experimenting with something called a "samophlange".

Now what the heck is a samophlange? Well, whatever it is, I want to examine it, so I need someone to go get it.

I obtained a copy of their control system operating manual, you should be able to figure out how to disengage the samophlange from it.
894-accept.title: Samophlange

895-accept.name: Unknown
895-accept.text:
WANTED!

Baron Longshore, Captain of the Heedless

Captain Longshore of Gilneas leads vessels of the Southsea Freebooters, and is wanted on charges of piracy. Remains must be in identifiable condition!

-- Gazlowe
895-accept.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

895-complete.name: Gazlowe
895-complete.text:
Ahhhh! That sort of business. You know, I saw the Heedless once on the open seas. Fearsome ship, or was that boat... those sailors are so particular!

Anyways, watching her glide across the water was quite a sight to see. I'm glad her infamous captain will trouble my ships no longer.
895-complete.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

895-progress.name: Gazlowe
895-progress.text: What's happening? Something I can help you with? Goods to ship, perhaps an engineering job?
895-progress.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

896-accept.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
896-accept.text:
Being Wharfmaster of a busy port like Ratchet, I keep my finger on the pulse of information. I know all about the exchange of goods and money between here and Booty Bay.

The latest bit of news I've heard is about the Venture Company's Boulder Lode mine northeast of the Sludge Fen. One of the miners discovered an emerald the size of your fist. I know a few buyers who'd be interested in getting their hands on something like that, and I'd be willing to go half and half on its sale.
896-accept.title: Miner's Fortune

898-accept.name: Gilthares Firebough
898-accept.text:
Finally! Someone to rescue me!

I can't believe you got past the guards. These zealots from Theramore are out of their minds. They sank our ship and imprisoned me, the only survivor. I was called an enemy and threat to the Alliance.

Me! A threat to their great sham of an Alliance? I was a deckhand on a moonshine transport between Ratchet and Booty Bay.

Enough talk. Help me get back to Ratchet will you? Let me know when you're ready and we'll make our break.
898-accept.title: Free From the Hold

899-accept.name: Mankrik
899-accept.text:
Perhaps you know the pain of uncertainty, perhaps not, $c. But know this: I stand here every day, from the sun's rising till its decline, scouring the horizon for more of those monsters. I've killed every pig man I've come across since, but my thirst for their blood is far from quenched. Perhaps instead of heading north to the Crossroads I should have headed to Taurajo.

You, $c--you  could help me.

Kill them. Kill as many as you can. Bring me their tusks, and we will celebrate their deaths together.
899-accept.title: Consumed by Hatred

9-accept.name: Farmer Saldean
9-accept.text:
Look at what has happened to this place!  These lands were once occupied by good farm folk.  But the damned thieves have driven them all off.  Not me, though!  But it seems some Harvest Watchers have taken over the fields.

If you're up for the work, I'd like you to go out and kill twenty of them.  Come back when you're done for your pay.  If you finish up with the ones in my field, clear them from the neighboring fields as well.
9-accept.title: The Killing Fields

9-complete.name: Farmer Saldean
9-complete.text: Good work, friend.  You have earned your pay well.  Who knows, perhaps Westfall will prosper once again.
9-complete.title: The Killing Fields

900-progress.name: Control Console
900-progress.text: Blinking lights on the control console indicate that the main control valves have not been closed off.
900-progress.title: Samophlange

901-progress.name: Control Console
901-progress.text: The console lights are dimmed and the gauges and dials all read at their zero positions, everything idling.
901-progress.title: Samophlange

902-progress.name: Sputtervalve
902-progress.text: Oh, you're back, $N! Do you have the samophlange?
902-progress.title: Samophlange

903-accept.name: Sergra Darkthorn
903-accept.text:
Now it's time to go after something that really bites.  The prowlers of the Barrens are a tough breed.  Tough, resourceful, sly... and deadly.  You'll find them among the tall grasses.  You'll find many to the southwest of the Crossroads.

Be wary as you hunt them, $N, or you may find yourself no longer the predator, but instead the prey.
903-accept.title: Prowlers of the Barrens

903-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
903-progress.text: How goes your hunt, $N?  Have you found the prowlers?
903-progress.title: Prowlers of the Barrens

90902-accept.name: Aramis Hammerhand
90902-accept.text:
I am proud to welcome another newly risen $c to our ranks. As you begin to reconnect with the light you may notice that certain abilities that were once second nature to you may cause you considerable pain to use now, particularly those involving channeling the light to heal yourself or others. 

The only way around this problem is--unfortunately--to go through it. Like any other muscle that has atrophied, you must push through the pain and exercise the flesh for it to return to full function.
90902-accept.title: Rediscovering the Light

90902-complete.name: Aramis Hammerhand
90902-complete.text:
Pain is nothing new to those who have endured death, and as such the Forsaken are particularly hardy to it. Pain has a purifying property as well that you should embrace as a badge of honor and evidence that you are, in fact, still a servant of the light despite your new circumstances. 

Be well and walk in the light once more, $c.
90902-complete.title: Rediscovering the Light

90902-progress.name: Aramis Hammerhand
90902-progress.text: Mastery of the light will return, in time.
90902-progress.title: Rediscovering the Light

91208-accept.name: Aramis Hammerhand
91208-accept.text:
Not all of our fellow Paladins who rise again are quick to acclimate to our new reality. Some struggle to reconcile that they are now, in a way, the very thing they spent their lives fighting against.

These individuals often simply need a kind gesture and a sympathetic ear. Unfortunately, many others are quick to turn violent. Find the frightened $c who fled into the hills directly west of this chapel. Extend a hand in friendship. Lead them back into the light if you can.
91208-accept.title: Coming to Terms

91208-complete.name: Aramis Hammerhand
91208-complete.text:
Tragically, more than a few of our brothers and sisters succumb to a similar madness after being risen. As precious as every Forsaken soul is, sometimes the best we can do is grant those that cannot acclimate a clean end.

I will say a prayer to the light for her. Thank you for doing what must be done, $N.
91208-complete.title: Coming to Terms

91209-accept.name: Aramis Hammerhand
91209-accept.text:
Lordaeron may not be what it used to be, but our home still needs protection from all manner of threats and it's time for you to go out and face the world. Your next stop should be the town of Brill in central Tirisfal Glades. Go and meet with Shari Stilwell there. She can see to your continued training. 

One last bit of advice before you go--take extra care as a $c traveling through Forsaken lands. There are many in the Dark Lady's service who distrust us and our proximity to the light.
91209-accept.title: Continue Your Training

91209-complete.name: Shari Stilwell
91209-complete.text:
Welcome aboard, $c. It's always encouraging to see more of our number roaming these lands. There are many here in Brill in need of assistance from adventurers such as yourself. Seek employment and grow stronger in the light. Return to me whenever you need training. 

When you've proven yourself to myself and the people of Brill, I will provide guidance for the next leg of your journey.

Go with the light, $c.
91209-complete.title: Continue Your Training

91282-accept.name: Shari Stilwell
91282-accept.text:
It is encouraging to see my newly risen brothers and sisters thrive as you have. It is only through community and shared faith that we can truly realize our full potential however, and to that end we've begun to form a new paladin order right here in Tirisfal. 

If you wish to learn more, you should visit our monastery at Northface Rock. It is called Bandarion Keep. It's on the bluffs just northwest of the Solliden Farmstead, and should be hard to miss.
91282-accept.title: A Second Home

91282-complete.name: Breton Samuels
91282-complete.text: Another fresh recruit? Welcome to Tyr's Watch, $g brother:sister;.
91282-complete.title: A Second Home

91285-accept.name: Breton Samuels
91285-accept.text:
Normally we'd show our newcomers a bit more hospitality, but we've got a bit of a murloc problem at the moment.

A tribe of murlocs used to use the keep as their spawning grounds. They've been a problem since we moved in and kicked them out, but now it's starting to get out of hand. You look like you've seen some action. Do you think you could help us drive back some of these pests? You'll find them lurking in the bluffs along the road to the east, and in the camps around the lake to the west.
91285-accept.title: Murlocs at the Gates

91285-complete.name: Breton Samuels
91285-complete.text: We appreciate the assistance. I'm sure this won't stop the attacks entirely, but it'll hopefully slow them down a bit. It's hard enough rebuilding this place without a murloc trying to stab you in the back with a spear.
91285-complete.title: Murlocs at the Gates

91294-accept.name: Breton Samuels
91294-accept.text:
Now that the immediate threat of the murloc attacks is under control, I'd encourage you to show yourself around our stronghold. It isn't much yet, but it's home.

When you are done exploring, seek out Danitha Morr, our leader. She can help you get settled in.

I'm very glad to have met you, $N. May the light be your guide.
91294-accept.title: Touring the Grounds

91294-complete.name: Danitha Morr
91294-complete.text:
Breton sent you up here, eh? Excellent.

My name is Danitha Morr, and I am the closest thing this keep has to a commander. If you come seeking fellowship amongst those that still remain loyal to the light, you've come to the right place.

There's a lot of work to do here before we can fully establish ourselves, and we'd be most appreciative if you would be willing to lend aid.
91294-complete.title: Touring the Grounds

91316-accept.name: Jorin Croge
91316-accept.text:
This far from the Undercity, logistics are challenging and we have a dire shortage of building materials needed to help restore this fortress. I'd like your help with that.

The ruined village of Shadowvale can be found in the Whispering Forest, just southwest of here. One of the buildings has an old root cellar used to store all sorts of things. There are likely to be usable materials down there. Scavenge what you can and return to us.
91316-accept.title: Making Repairs

91316-complete.name: Jorin Croge
91316-complete.text: I'm glad to see that your trip to Shadowvale bore fruit. I'll send Breton and a few of the other new recruits over later to clear the rest of the cellar out and retrieve anything left down in the dark.
91316-complete.title: Making Repairs

91316-progress.name: Jorin Croge
91316-progress.text: They say location is everything. While this fortress may look imposing perched upon these bluffs, its turning out to be quite the challenge to stay supplied this far from proper civilization. An unfortunate oversight on our part.
91316-progress.title: Making Repairs

91317-accept.name: Danitha Morr
91317-accept.text:
Not all risen paladins have acclimated well to our new existence, as you may have seen yourself already. Some have carried forward their prejudices from life, and continue to visit violence upon their fellow Forsaken.

As it stands we are mistrusted by our people who remember well the persecution inflicted by the living in the name of the light, and these attacks do not help. A number of these tarnished have taken up residence at Shadowvale to the southwest. End them and bring me their leader's head.
91317-accept.title: The Tarnished

91317-complete.name: Danitha Morr
91317-complete.text:
Excellent work, $N. Every time one of these Tarnished strike out and kill one of the Forsaken, it becomes that much easier for our detractors to stoke mistrust towards us paladins. Eliminating them will help further our cause and solidify our place here in Tirisfal.

I suspect it may take a long time for us to be fully embraced by the Forsaken and the horde. It could take years... or maybe even decades, but the best we can do is keep trying to prove ourselves.
91317-complete.title: The Tarnished

91317-progress.name: Danitha Morr
91317-progress.text: The Tarnished threaten what little goodwill we have with the other Forsaken. As much as it pains me to cross blades with our former brothers and sisters, they must be stopped if our fledgling order is to survive.
91317-progress.title: The Tarnished

914-accept.name: Nara Wildmane
914-accept.text:
The druids in the Wailing Caverns, the Druids of the Fang, are an aberration.  They were part of an order of noble druids whose plan was to heal the Barrens, but now seek to remake that land to match their own, twisted dreams.

The Druids of the Fang have four leaders, and each possesses a dream gem.  Even now their faces haunt me!  Defeat the leaders and bring me their gems, and the Barrens may again know peace.

Go, $N.  You will find them lurking deep within the Wailing Caverns.
914-accept.title: Leaders of the Fang

914-complete.name: Nara Wildmane
914-complete.text:
You have done it, $N.  You killed the leaders of the Druids of the Fang.  My dreams are now free of their wicked faces, and you have helped save the Barrens from a cursed future.

I thank you, $N.  I thank you for myself, for the druids of Thunder Bluff, and for the land.
914-complete.title: Leaders of the Fang

914-progress.name: Nara Wildmane
914-progress.text: Memories of my nightmares haunt me, $N.  Have you defeated the leaders of the fang and acquired their gems?
914-progress.title: Leaders of the Fang

916-accept.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
916-accept.text:
I came to Shadowglen to observe the webwood spiders that dwell in the Shadowthread Cave.  They are cousin to a much smaller variety of spider; I believe the world tree has had a profound effect on them, and I would like specimens to study to confirm this.

First, I would like some of their venom.  Gather Webwood venom sacs from the spiders in and around the Shadowthread Cave, to the north.  I can then examine them for similarities with their smaller cousin's venom.
916-accept.title: Webwood Venom

916-complete.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
916-complete.text: Thank you, $N.  When I return to Darnassus I will compare the venom within these sacs with the venom of other spiders.  It is my belief that it will have properties linked to the recent growth of our new world tree.
916-complete.title: Webwood Venom

916-progress.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
916-progress.text: Did you gather the venom sacs, $N?
916-progress.title: Webwood Venom

917-accept.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
917-accept.text:
Now that I have the spiders' venom, I'd like some live specimens to study.  Unfortunately, capturing a living, giant spider is more than I can ask of you, young $c.  And a giant spider is more than I could handle myself!

But if you can find an unhatched egg, then delivering specimens will be much easier, and I can then arrange for the unhatched spiders to be contained.

There must be a nest deep in the Shadowthread Cave.  Please, search for an egg in the nest and return it to me.
917-accept.title: Webwood Egg

917-complete.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
917-complete.text: Ah, very good.  I will have this egg and the venom transported to Darnassus, then return there when my studies are done here.  I expect to find out a great deal from these specimens, $N.  You have been a great help to me.
917-complete.title: Webwood Egg

917-progress.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
917-progress.text: Have you been inside the Shadowthread Cave, $N?  Did you find a spider egg?
917-progress.title: Webwood Egg

91723-accept.name: Hamish Bergwort
91723-accept.text:
Blast it! Every time I try to calibrate these sensitive arcane instruments, they get thrown off again by a surge of energy.
The surges seem to be coming from the north, where those primitive Kobolds have been practicing their crude magic. Could you clear some of them out, so I can continue my work?
91723-accept.title: Delicate Instruments

91723-complete.name: Hamish Bergwort
91723-complete.text: Well done, my friend. Let me try my calibrations again...
91723-complete.title: Delicate Instruments

91724-accept.name: Hamish Bergwort
91724-accept.text:
Almost there, and... By the Nether! Something is still disrupting my instruments.
This is most frustrating, $N. I have heard rumors that the local bandits have been practicing spells near Stone Cairn Lake. Maybe if you stop them, these disruptions will finally cease and I can get some work done?
91724-accept.title: Delicate Instruments

91724-complete.name: Hamish Bergwort
91724-complete.text: It seems like everything is working properly. Thank you, $N.
91724-complete.title: Delicate Instruments

91725-accept.name: Blixie Fitzwink
91725-accept.text:
I was sent by Master Theocritus to pick up some enchanting supplies from the trading post, but on the way back I was ambushed by a pack of gnolls!

I dropped the package and escaped, but if I return without it, I'll be cleaning up after the polymorph experiments for weeks as punishment! Do you think you could find the supplies for me?
91725-accept.title: Stolen Enchanting Supplies

91725-complete.name: Blixie Fitzwink
91725-complete.text: Oh, that's a relief! It looks like it's all here. Thank you!
91725-complete.title: Stolen Enchanting Supplies

91732-accept.name: Hagar Lowe
91732-accept.text: Good steel is in short supply after the war, and our tools have suffered for it. The Jasperlode miners used finely-crafted picks, and I imagine some of them are still there in the depths of the mine. Could you retrieve some for me, and I'll see if I can repurpose the steel?
91732-accept.title: Good Steel

91732-complete.name: Hagar Lowe
91732-complete.text: Oh, very nice. Do you see that shine? Truly, they don't make them like they used to.
91732-complete.title: Good Steel

91732-progress.name: Hagar Lowe
91732-progress.text: Have you been to the mine yet?
91732-progress.title: Good Steel

91733-accept.name: Ormin Pelford
91733-accept.text:
I was bringing back a supply shipment from the trading post, but my wagon tipped over and the supplies fell in the river! Before I could catch them, they had already washed downstream.
Between the murlocs and wolves down there, I don't stand a chance of retrieving the supplies on my own. You seem like the hardy sort - do you think you could find them for me?
91733-accept.title: Downstream

91733-complete.name: Ormin Pelford
91733-complete.text: You look a bit damp, $N. Sorry about that. But thank you for retrieving the supplies.
91733-complete.title: Downstream

91740-accept.name: Unknown
91740-accept.text: This murloc has no doubt been terrorizing the local roads for some time. You suspect the nearby watch guards will want to know of its demise.
91740-accept.title: Croaky's Head

91741-accept.name: Unknown
91741-accept.text:
<One of the kobolds dropped this book. It looks like the kobold might have tried to eat it.

Brother Paxton inside the abbey has a small library he maintains. The book must have come from there.>
91741-accept.title: Nibbled-On Book

91741-complete.name: Brother Paxton
91741-complete.text:
Hey! How did you end up with that? It's supposed to be on the shelf! Oh dear, the kobolds have been stealing my books again. They must want to eat them!

Thanks for bringing back the book, but what will I do about the rest of my missing collection?
91741-complete.title: Nibbled-On Book

91741-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91741-progress.text: What's that you got there? It looks like one of my books.
91741-progress.title: Nibbled-On Book

91743-accept.name: Brother Paxton
91743-accept.text: Those awful kobolds are eating my books! You have to get them back before they devour my whole library.
91743-accept.title: Rascally Rodents

91743-complete.name: Brother Paxton
91743-complete.text:
Thank you so much! Here! Take one of these how-to books. I don't need them.

But there's still so many books missing. The kobolds don't seem to be eating them. So, why do they want them?
91743-complete.title: Rascally Rodents

91743-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91743-progress.text: Have you rescued my books yet, $N?!
91743-progress.title: Rascally Rodents

91745-accept.name: Brother Paxton
91745-accept.text: Go talk to the new mining apprentice, Kelsey Fargo. She works right outside the mine and has probably seen what the kobolds are up to. Maybe she can teach you a thing or two about mining while you're at it.
91745-accept.title: Mining Consultant

91745-complete.name: Kelsey Fargo
91745-complete.text: Kobolds with books? Yah, I've seen kobolds running back and forth with books, yelling at each other. They must be stealing them from the library inside the abbey.
91745-complete.title: Mining Consultant

91751-accept.name: Helene Peltskinner
91751-accept.text: Are you looking for an opportunity to practice skinning? My husband usually helps with hunting wolves, but he's busy up by the abbey. I could use a hand collecting more pelts to finish the orders I'm working on.
91751-accept.title: Rough Wolf Pelts

91751-complete.name: Helene Peltskinner
91751-complete.text: Excellent work collecting these pelts, $c. You have a real talent for hunting.
91751-complete.title: Rough Wolf Pelts

91751-progress.name: Helene Peltskinner
91751-progress.text: Any luck with those wolf pelts?
91751-progress.title: Rough Wolf Pelts

91752-accept.name: Kelsey Fargo
91752-accept.text:
Every once in a while, a kobold comes through yelling "Picture for Narf!" I don't know who Narf is. Maybe one of the head kobolds at the back of the mine? I bet he has a whole sack of books by now.

Go get those books and bring them to our local law enforcement, Marshal McBride. You should find a friend to help. Those kobolds inside the mine are a lot meaner.
91752-accept.title: The Big Picture

91752-complete.name: Marshal McBride
91752-complete.text:
Thank you for returning these stolen books, $N. I'll get them back to Brother Paxton at once.

You're becoming quite the hero around here. Great job!
91752-complete.title: The Big Picture

91752-progress.name: Marshal McBride
91752-progress.text: Have you retrieved those stolen books yet?
91752-progress.title: The Big Picture

91753-accept.name: Kitta Firewind
91753-accept.text:
Academic rigor is of course essential to the enchanter's craft, but a practical foundation can pay dividends. Consider, as an example, the lowly Kobold. Lacking formal education, they nevertheless demonstrate a sort of innate aptitude for simple cantrips and enchantments.

Obtain some of their wax effigies and deconstruct the enchantments bound within them. You may find it elucidating.
91753-accept.title: An Enchanting Lesson

91753-complete.name: Kitta Firewind
91753-complete.text: Theory and practice are two sides of a coin, $N. Remember this.
91753-complete.title: An Enchanting Lesson

91758-accept.name: Marshal McBride
91758-accept.text:
You're not done with those kobolds yet. We just got word from Kelsey that a kobold left the mine carrying a large sack of books. I need you to track down this kobold so we can retrieve the books for Brother Paxton.

Go talk to Tordrin Sternblade. He's the new Hunter trainer that just arrived from Ironforge. You can find him behind the abbey, near the stable. He can help you track this kobold thief.
91758-accept.title: Follow That Kobold!

91758-complete.name: Tordrin Sternblade
91758-complete.text: I can help ye' track down this varmint. Let me whip somethin' up for ye'.
91758-complete.title: Follow That Kobold!

91772-accept.name: Tordrin Sternblade
91772-accept.text:
Alright. Take this kobold tracking kit. It'll let ye' track the kobold that Marshal McBride is concerned with.

Follow the tracks and bring what ye' find to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

I have a feelin' these varmints are up to somethin' outside Northshire. So ye'll be needin' Dughan's help.
91772-accept.title: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds

91772-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
91772-complete.text:
What's this, $N? Tracking kobolds?

Well, of course they're headed toward the Fargodeep mine! That place is infested with kobolds.

Good work, I guess. I'm going to need someone to take care of that problem.
91772-complete.title: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds

91772-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
91772-progress.text: Have you figured out where the Kobolds are heading?
91772-progress.title: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds

91775-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
91775-accept.text:
While you're investigating the Fargodeep Mine, see if you can find any of Brother Paxton's books to return. In particular, Paxton is very concerned about a book titled, "Fun with Elementals". He thinks even a kobold could use it to summon an elemental servant. Be warned, the depths of the mine are fairly dangerous. You should bring friends.

Take this book bag to protect the books when you find them!
91775-accept.title: Book Return

91775-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
91775-complete.text:
I applaud your diligence, $N. Brother Paxton sent a list of books, and you've found most of the missing ones. The rest must have been taken to the Jasperlode Mine.

You can keep that book bag!
91775-complete.title: Book Return

91775-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
91775-progress.text: Have you found all the books yet?
91775-progress.title: Book Return

91777-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
91777-accept.text:
There's just two books left missing on Brother Paxton's list: "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words".

The kobolds must have taken them to the Jasperlode Mine. Please track down those two books and bring them back to Brother Paxton.

But I'm afraid it will be quite dangerous. If the "apprentice" kobold was summoning an elemental, who knows what the master can do. I'd bring some friends if I were you.
91777-accept.title: Rare Books

91777-complete.name: Brother Paxton
91777-complete.text: Oh, $N! Thank you so much for saving my library. You've done me an amazing service. Please take one of these fine weapons. They were intended for the militia, but you can make better use of them.
91777-complete.title: Rare Books

91777-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91777-progress.text: Have you found all my missing books yet?
91777-progress.title: Rare Books

918-accept.name: Denalan
918-accept.text:
The timberlings of Teldrassil are elementals of nature.  In some ways they reflect the natural order of plants and animals on our great tree.

So it is disturbing to see how angry the timberlings have become.

I believe it has something to do with the soil.  I have been working on different methods of nurturing plants and would like to try them on timberling seeds.  Please, can you gather seeds from timberlings around Lake Al'Ameth and bring them to me?
918-accept.title: Timberling Seeds

918-complete.name: Denalan
918-complete.text:
You got them.  This is good!

I will plant these seeds in special soil I have prepared.  I believe the seeds will sprout into timberlings who are much more docile.  Perhaps later you can see the results!
918-complete.title: Timberling Seeds

918-progress.name: Denalan
918-progress.text: Do you have the seeds?  I am eager to plant them.
918-progress.title: Timberling Seeds

91858-accept.name: Danitha Morr
91858-accept.text:
A most unfortunate turn of events in Silverpine has presented a unique opportunity for us to prove our worth in the eyes of the horde.

A pair of dignitaries from the Earthen Ring went missing in Silverpine Forest en route to Tarren Mill. We don't know much else but rumors say that this is becoming quite the diplomatic incident. If we can recover these missing persons, it could help gain us the legitimacy we so dearly need.

We have a man at The Sepulcher, Trevan Rol. Travel there and speak with him.
91858-accept.title: Diplomatic Incident

91858-complete.name: Trevan Rol
91858-complete.text: Danitha sent you? Well in that case I already know why you are here. You just walked into a damned fine mess, $c.
91858-complete.title: Diplomatic Incident

91859-accept.name: Trevan Rol
91859-accept.text:
Cutting straight to it, these "dignitaries" are no ordinary diplomats. One was a Tauren. Ordinary enough for the Earthen Ring, but the other--and you'll scarcely believe this--was an elf. A *high* elf. They were cloaked, but I've seen quel'dorei before and I'd bet my good pinky finger that's what I saw.

Why was an elf accompanying a Tauren through horde territory? Well, your guess is as good as mine. That's as much as I know, so I'd suggest speaking with Deathguard Baldren near the entrance to town.
91859-accept.title: A Curious Pair

91859-complete.name: Deathguard Baldren
91859-complete.text: I might not care for you paladins, but I will say that your timing is impeccable. It's better to be lucky than good, I suppose?
91859-complete.title: A Curious Pair

91860-accept.name: Deathguard Baldren
91860-accept.text:
Out on patrol last night I spotted a group of gnolls dumping a very large body onto a pyre on the shores of Fenris Isle. I didn't see an elf or any smaller corpses, but I'd say this doesn't bode well for them.

If you are brave or stupid you are welcome to charge into Fenris Isle to learn more, but if you ask me, its a lot of work to find some snooty elf that's probably long dead.

I know you paladins love swearing oaths and taking on lost causes, but this one isn't worth it. Trust me.
91860-accept.title: A Grim Fate

91860-complete.name: Unknown
91860-complete.text:
<The corpse before you was certainly Tauren and you can tell that it was gnawed on heavily before it was tossed onto the pyre. You see no signs of the elf woman that was described to you though. Perhaps she is still alive somewhere deeper in the fortress nearby?

This will be dangerous, but there's only one way to find out for sure.>
91860-complete.title: A Grim Fate

91861-accept.name: Unknown
91861-accept.text: <The fact that you only found only one body is a hopeful sign. Perhaps the High Elf that Trevan and Hadrec described is still alive somewhere deeper inside the nearby fortress?>
91861-accept.title: Into Fenris Keep

91861-complete.name: Lumina Windsinger
91861-complete.text:
You are one of the Forsaken, yes? Can you help free me? 

Time is short for me, I am afraid. Please hurry!
91861-complete.title: Into Fenris Keep

91862-accept.name: Lumina Windsinger
91862-accept.text:
Quel'dorei? No, I am no "quel'dorei". I am Lumina Windsinger and I am shen'dorei. One of the Windshaper Skyborne.

I came to these lands as a guest of the Earthen Ring. My companion Banon and I were passing through Silverpine to reach the Arathi Highlands so that we could study the elemental convergences there. Clearly, we didn't make it.

We have no time for this now though. Kill the gnolls nearby. Retrieve the key to this cage and free me. I will tell you the rest once we are safely away.
91862-accept.title: Lumina Windsinger

91862-complete.name: Lumina Windsinger
91862-complete.text: Thank you, $c. Unfortunately we aren't out of danger yet.
91862-complete.title: Lumina Windsinger

91862-progress.name: Lumina Windsinger
91862-progress.text: Gnolls are the second worst creatures I've encountered yet on Azeroth.
91862-progress.title: Lumina Windsinger

91899-complete.name: Marcy Baker
91899-complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates laying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.
91899-complete.title: A Sealed Crate

91899-progress.name: Marcy Baker
91899-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91899-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

919-accept.name: Denalan
919-accept.text:
Small timberlings are sprouting around the waters of Lake Al'Ameth.  I'm afraid these sprouts are beyond help -- we should try to clear them from the land before they grow large enough to cause trouble.

When you're wandering the lake, if you see any timberling sprouts please take them.  Help keep our land clean!
919-accept.title: Timberling Sprouts

919-complete.name: Denalan
919-complete.text:
That's a lot!  I'm afraid they're spreading at a dangerous rate.  I hope I can solve the riddle of what is tainting them.

Thank you for your help, $N.  The land is a cleaner place from your efforts.
919-complete.title: Timberling Sprouts

919-progress.name: Denalan
919-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you found any sprouts near the waters?
919-progress.title: Timberling Sprouts

91900-complete.name: Marcy Baker
91900-complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates laying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.
91900-complete.title: A Sealed Crate

91900-progress.name: Marcy Baker
91900-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91900-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

91904-complete.name: Marcy Baker
91904-complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates laying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.
91904-complete.title: A Sealed Crate

91904-progress.name: Marcy Baker
91904-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91904-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

91920-accept.name: Quinn Yorick
91920-accept.text:
I wouldn't dare to question the effectiveness of Apothecary Renferrel's formulae, however I would be lying if I said that the potion made any noticeable difference.

Along the shore of Lake Lordamere are a swarm of murlocs, and of note, murlocs have eyes. I suspect the apothecary's willingness to try new things is suppressed by his recent obsession with hearts. Bring him a few.

If my choice is to inevitably die a second death or have Renferrel kill me for questioning his methods, I choose the latter.
91920-accept.title: Wild Eyes

91920-complete.name: Apothecary Renferrel
91920-complete.text:
The potion didn't work? Of course it didn't work. You brought me insufficient hearts. The recipe clearly calls for six. You brought three.

However, I confess I hadn't considered applications for murloc parts until now...

<Renferrel takes the eyes.>

I can afford to sacrifice a few of my own hearts to get your Deathstalker's strength back.
91920-complete.title: Wild Eyes

91921-accept.name: Apothecary Renferrel
91921-accept.text:
Here is the new potion to aid in Quinn's recovery, made with love extracted from six whole hearts.

Now, please excuse me before your presence necessitates more paperwork.
91921-accept.title: Return to Quinn (Again)

91921-complete.name: Quinn Yorick
91921-complete.text:
<Quinn takes the potion and drinks it.>

Yes, I can feel it working.  I will soon be able to travel.

You have done me a great favor, $N.
91921-complete.title: Return to Quinn (Again)

91921-progress.name: Quinn Yorick
91921-progress.text: You return! I was beginning to come to terms with devolving into a ghoul.
91921-progress.title: Return to Quinn (Again)

920-accept.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
920-accept.text:
$N, is it? I heard that Tenaron has been asking for you. You'll find him in the highest room atop Aldrassil.

We may live long lives, but it's best you not keep him waiting too long.
920-accept.title: Tenaron's Summons

920-complete.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
920-complete.text: Ah, $N. I was hoping you'd be prompt in answering my summons. I have an important task that I would like you to perform.
920-complete.title: Tenaron's Summons

921-accept.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
921-accept.text:
It is time for you to set out to seek your destiny, $N. But before you are ready to set out into the world beyond our enchanted forests, there is much you must learn about our recent history.

Much has changed with our people since the Battle of Mount Hyjal. Nordrassil lies a pale shadow of what it once was, its power used to defeat Archimonde and drive back the Burning Legion...

There is a task you must perform. Go to the moonwell north of Aldrassil and return me a phial of its water.
921-accept.title: Crown of the Earth

921-complete.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
921-complete.text: So you have heard the first part of the aftermath of the Battle of Mount Hyjal. There is much more to be told and the task you have begun here will continue through the rest of your journey through Teldrassil and into Darnassus.
921-complete.title: Crown of the Earth

921-progress.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
921-progress.text:
The moonwells hold the waters of the Well of Eternity, the ancient source of magic that has wrought so many horrors upon our world.

The druids take advantage of its properties, and the Sentinels revere the wells as shrines to Elune, but sorcery is forbidden to all.
921-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

92124-accept.name: Brother Paxton
92124-accept.text:
We need to take stock of how many books are missing!

Go talk to my useless assistant, Daniel. He can do a quick inventory and let us know how serious the problem is.

He's obsessed with the various trade professions in Elwynn Forest. The boy keeps focusing on those instead of his important work helping me.

Don't let him prattle on about tradeskills, and find out what's happened to my books!
92124-accept.title: Book Inventory

92124-complete.name: Daniel
92124-complete.text:
Yah, I overheard. I warned Brother Paxton three times about the kobolds tunneling under the abbey.

It looks like the kobolds have taken a lot of books. There are whole bookshelves emptied out. You should probably see what Brother Paxton wants you to do about it.

While you're here, can I talk to you about tradeskills? I'd be happy to answer any questions you have, or point you toward the local trainers.
92124-complete.title: Book Inventory

922-accept.name: Denalan
922-accept.text:
$N, can you take one of the seeds you brought me to my friend, Rellian Greenspyre?  He is a druid in Darnassus, and when last we spoke he revealed his interest in my work with the Timberlings.  He had some ideas himself, and he will appreciate a specimen seed to work with.

Thank you, $N.  You have been a great help to me.  I hope that, some day, you will see the fruit of my labors.

You will usually find Rellian walking the pathways of the Cenarian Enclave in Darnassus.
922-accept.title: Rellian Greenspyre

922-complete.name: Rellian Greenspyre
922-complete.text:
Ah, a timberling seed?  I wanted to try growing one of these to help Denalan with his studies.

But I'm afraid I've discovered that a corruption has grown in many of the timberlings, and seeds from such creatures carry their parent's taint.  They are beyond my talents to repair.

Denalan is very skilled with things that grow.  He may find a cure for future timberlings.  He may be their only hope.
922-complete.title: Rellian Greenspyre

922-progress.name: Rellian Greenspyre
922-progress.text:
Hello...

And how may I help you?
922-progress.title: Rellian Greenspyre

923-accept.name: Rellian Greenspyre
923-accept.text:
There is a malevolence growing in the timberlings.  We are trying to find the source, but until we do...in order to keep Teldrassil safe we must cut down the timberlings who are beyond help.  Those that wander Wellspring Lake in northern Teldrassil are the most tainted.  They must be removed!

Destroy the Timberlings you find there, and gather the mossy tumors growing upon them.  Bring the tumors to me so that they may be burned.
923-accept.title: Tumors

923-complete.name: Rellian Greenspyre
923-complete.text:
Well done!  These tumors are the symptom of the timberling's disease.  They are filled with a poison that we must cleanse from our new land.

I will dispose of these tumors.  Thank you, $N.
923-complete.title: Tumors

923-progress.name: Rellian Greenspyre
923-progress.text: Have you been to Wellspring Lake, $N?  Have you been hunting the timberlings there?
923-progress.title: Tumors

924-accept.name: Ak'Zeloth
924-accept.text:
The Demon Seed is a powerful tool for the Burning Legion. It rests in a cave on Dreadmist Peak, above a demonic altar of fire.

I have prepared power stones that when placed near the Seed will disrupt its connection to the Legion.

Take a stone from the table and bring it to the altar of fire atop Dreadmist Peak. Travel west, then north when the road forks. The Peak will be to your left. The safest climb to the top is on its northern face.

And hurry--the stone's power will consume itself in time.
924-accept.title: The Demon Seed

92401-accept.name: Tabitha Heartweaver
92401-accept.text:
It's my husband Edward...

He has not returned from his weekly journey to the graveyard in the Lordaeron ruins. Our son was lost when Arthas razed the city, and my dear Edward is still filled with guilt and sorrow that we never found his body. I've tried to warn him against searching those overrun ruins, but he refuses to give up. I try not worry, but it's been days.

There are things there I cannot contend with but if you are willing, I need to know the fate of my husband.
92401-accept.title: A Frightened Request

92401-complete.name: Tabitha Heartweaver
92401-complete.text:
What I asked of you was not fair, nor would it have been unjust for you to simply walk away. Thank you stranger. I am unable to repay you in kind but I hope one of these is acceptable.

I hope our paths cross again without such sorrow.
92401-complete.title: A Frightened Request

92421-accept.name: Morbin Lightbane
92421-accept.text:
As a paladin of the Forsaken, it is my duty to exact the will of our Dark Lady while tending to our people's needs. We are fortunate with an opportunity to accomplish both.

Above the Undercity, the scourge still roam unchecked in great numbers. Our forces dwindle trying to reclaim our land, and decaying flesh cannot be reknit. Not without replacements.

Would that our glorious captain Garek Bandarion still be with us, I know what he would wish. To finish what he started and heal our kin. For Lordaeron!
92421-accept.title: Light's Justice

92421-complete.name: Morbin Lightbane
92421-complete.text:
Let those who fall from the Banshee Queen's grace meet our justice!

With these parts, our brothers and sisters have hope to see another day. You do Captain Bandarion proud.
92421-complete.title: Light's Justice

92421-progress.name: Morbin Lightbane
92421-progress.text: What remains of the invading scourge? Have you managed to find suitable replacement parts?
92421-progress.title: Light's Justice

92422-accept.name: Deathguard Kristof
92422-accept.text:
Reports have come in from the Lordamere Overlook deep within the Ruins of Lordaeron. An unholy fog has taken over the streets and graveyard, affording the scourge up there some measure of stealth. 

Our scouts indicate they're being conjured by a new power within their ranks, a necromancer known as Rath'mael. We do not have the luxury of waiting this one out, $N.

If you have allies, summon them and their aid to the Forsaken. Drive this creature out of our lands.
92422-accept.title: The Wrath of Rath'mael

92422-complete.name: Deathguard Kristof
92422-complete.text:
While I have no doubt something of his kind will be replaced, we can only hope their ranks thin in the meantime.

Thank you $N.
92422-complete.title: The Wrath of Rath'mael

92460-accept.name: Ailee Farheart
92460-accept.text:
Look at you, bright eyed and ready for adventure! We've been awaiting your arrival and anticipating your much needed help here in Thendal Village. I imagine you are brimming with both nerves and excitement for what is to come. After all, you only get to come of age once in a lifetime.

<Ailee smiles kindly.>

Go, seek out our village leader Rorian the Dayseeker at the entrance to the greatfather tree just west of here. He will get you started on your journey.
92460-accept.title: Coming of Age

92460-complete.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92460-complete.text:
Gale's greetings, $N. I am honored to bestow your coming of age relic today as you are recognized for the potential you bring to the shen'dorei. Our people have faced great hardship and persecution in our complex history.

Today you are given this relic which is one of many held by those before you. Someday when your ashes are scattered to the winds it will pass to another to continue our tradition.

As you take this relic with you know that the winds of home will be with you wherever you travel.
92460-complete.title: Coming of Age

92461-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92461-accept.text:
We live in times of great uncertainty for our people. We face unprecedented challenges that may require bold solutions, but we also must contend with the ordinary and mundane here in Thendal Grove. Take, for example, the recent unsustainable rise in the vuldren population.

The vuldren are a vital part of our ecosystem. However, imbalances must be corrected to maintain the delicate harmony that all creatures in Thendal Grove share.

Head east and cull some of the vuldren there.
92461-accept.title: Harmony in Balance

92461-complete.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92461-complete.text:
Thank you for your service to Zephras, young $c.

The vuldren are typically quite docile, but the animals that call Zephras home can sense when the magic on the winds is out of balance, which can lead to dangerous and unpredictable behavior if left unchecked.
92461-complete.title: Harmony in Balance

92462-accept.name: Elatrell Featherlight
92462-accept.text:
One of our rangers recently reported an infestation of cirrusflies here in Thendal Grove. 

Cirrusflies can be dangerous if the swarm is allowed to grow too large, so please head to the eastern end of the Grove and exterminate as many as you can.
92462-accept.title: Infestation Investigation

92462-complete.name: Elatrell Featherlight
92462-complete.text: Judging by the amount of bug entrails covering you, this must be quite the infestation.
92462-complete.title: Infestation Investigation

92463-accept.name: Elatrell Featherlight
92463-accept.text:
If the forest is as thick with these insects as it sounds, simply killing the workers won't be enough.

Go deeper into the forest and find the queen. She'll be close to the hive and surrounded by bigger and more aggressive soldiers, so be careful.

Put her down and return here when it's done. That'll be one less problem to think about around here.
92463-accept.title: The Cirrusfly Queen

92463-complete.name: Elatrell Featherlight
92463-complete.text: Excellent work, $N. You'd make a fine ranger if this whole "adventurer" thing doesn't work out for you.
92463-complete.title: The Cirrusfly Queen

92463-progress.name: Elatrell Featherlight
92463-progress.text: Cirrusflies aren't to be underestimated. They might not seem dangerous, but you have to watch out for the bigger ones. The bigger they are, the meaner!
92463-progress.title: The Cirrusfly Queen

92464-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92464-accept.text:
Ever since our elemental benefactors left us, it seems that we are simply moving from one unrest to another. The problem we face now is that the manifestations of the winds near the standing stones to the northeast are agitated.

Not truly self-aware like the sentient wind spirits that once lived here, these simple sprites respond in kind to forces, emotions, and intentions of the creatures around them. 

My apprentice Yala Windwatcher went to observe them. Seek her out and discover what she's learned.
92464-accept.title: Elemental Unrest

92464-complete.name: Yala Windwatcher
92464-complete.text: Rorian sent you? Good. I could use your aid.
92464-complete.title: Elemental Unrest

92465-accept.name: Yala Windwatcher
92465-accept.text:
The Al'Aketh cult is a blight upon this island. These cultists are surely the ones responsible for agitating the simple wind sprites that reside here and turning them violent.

Regrettably, we'll need to disperse these roiling winds here before they harm someone. We also need to send a clear message to the cult that they are not welcome in the grove.

Will you lend me your aid, $c?
92465-accept.title: Agitators

92465-complete.name: Yala Windwatcher
92465-complete.text: It pains me to shed shen'dorei blood here in the grove, but we do what we must.
92465-complete.title: Agitators

92469-accept.name: Yala Windwatcher
92469-accept.text:
You've done enough here, $c. I'll stay and clean up any stragglers down there.

Head back to the Village and tell Rorian about the cult's presence. He will not be pleased.
92469-accept.title: Return to Rorian

92469-complete.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92469-complete.text:
This is most troubling, but unfortunately unsurprising. We've been aware of the cult's movements for some time, but we've been content to watch from afar. Their agitation of the wind spirits near the standing stones is a clear escalation on their part.

You've performed a difficult but necessary service for Thendal Grove, $N. Thank you.
92469-complete.title: Return to Rorian

92470-accept.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92470-accept.text:
Rorian informed you that I've been watching you. I now offer you a test of resolve. However, be warned--it will send you into great danger.

Go to the caves to the south. Thin out the ursera's numbers there, and find their matriarch, one the rangers call "Urs'anah". Put her down and bring me proof of her demise. Once you have done that, you will have taken an important step on your path.
92470-accept.title: Foul Matriarch

92470-complete.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92470-complete.text: Very well done. You've felled beasts and laid low cultist interlopers. You have shown great promise but your path must soon take you beyond the relative safety of Thendal Village.
92470-complete.title: Foul Matriarch

92470-progress.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92470-progress.text: What I ask of you is not easy, but you must be prepared for much greater challenges if you are to survive long enough to be of service to Zephras Isle.
92470-progress.title: Foul Matriarch

92471-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92471-accept.text:
You may not realize this but everything you've done has been a trial of sorts. A test for what is to come for you. It's a big island out there, and Zephras needs spirited young adventurers such as yourself if we are to survive the trials our people face.

The one called Aetheen of the Gales is one of the leaders of our people here on Zephras Isle, and she has been watching you. She has a task that you must complete. Speak with her to learn more.
92471-accept.title: Aetheen of the Gales

92471-complete.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92471-complete.text:
Rorian has told me much of you. I am likely unknown to you, but I am a member of the Council of Elders here on Zephras Isle. I've come to read the flow of the winds here in Thendal Grove. I'm also here to assess young shen'dorei such as yourself that are coming of age.

So tell me, are you ready to take your next step? Are you ready to serve Zephras Isle?
92471-complete.title: Aetheen of the Gales

92472-accept.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92472-accept.text:
One of the most pervasive threats on Zephras Isle is the Al'Aketh Cult. They are religious zealots devoted to the worship of the supposed elemental ruler of Skywall, Al'Akir the Windlord. They are brutal, single minded, and their power and ambitions are growing more deadly by the day.

Your path will soon take you to Shen'dar Village to the south. Present yourself to Constable Aonda when you arrive. The cult threatens Shen'dar and they are in need of aid. Tell Aonda that I sent you.
92472-accept.title: The Next Step

92472-complete.name: Constable Aonda
92472-complete.text: Aetheen sent you, then? I'll confess, you don't look like much to me, but Shen'dar Village won't turn down willing aid, much less aid sent from Elder Aetheen herself.
92472-complete.title: The Next Step

92473-accept.name: Valreaa Valewind
92473-accept.text:
The ursera den to the southwest is rapidly becoming a problem. Just last week the rangers had to kill an adolescent ursera who wandered too close to the village and attempted to attack a boy playing near the base of the elder tree in the center of the village.

We were fortunate that the boy escaped with his life. Hunger and desperation makes these beasts too dangerous to be left unchecked. Go south and put the scrawniest among the ursera down. Bring me their claws as proof when it is done.
92473-accept.title: Aggressive Encroachment

92473-complete.name: Valreaa Valewind
92473-complete.text: Well done, $c. The Rangers of the Grove are in your debt.
92473-complete.title: Aggressive Encroachment

92473-progress.name: Valreaa Valewind
92473-progress.text: The ursera have grown far more aggressive of late. I wonder what has changed to cause this shift in behavior?
92473-progress.title: Aggressive Encroachment

92474-accept.name: Myriaal Mistwake
92474-accept.text:
Well hello there, $N! Want to play a game?

All you've got to do is step up on that ledge... then jump! Use your innate ability to walk on the air to slow your fall and see how far forward you can float.

The rules are made up and the points don't matter, but you get bonus points if you can land right in front of Rorian the Dayseeker and startle him! He won't like it but I'll certainly get a good laugh if you can get him all worked up! Hah!
92474-accept.title: Falling With Style

92474-complete.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92474-complete.text:
How many times do I need to tell Myriaal not to encourage others to make reckless usage of our skyborne gifts!

That being said, I suppose that a little bit of practice in the relative safety of the village is... acceptable.

In the future I'd simply suggest you to use your ability judiciously. You do not want to exhaust your magic thoughtlessly and then not be able to use it when you truly need it.
92474-complete.title: Falling With Style

92479-accept.name: Marshal McBride
92479-accept.text: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $N. It appears to be a letter sealed with the mark of Tordrin Stemblade, our local $c trainer. Take a moment to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
92479-accept.title: A Scribbled Letter

92479-complete.name: Tordrin Sternblade
92479-complete.text:
Get yerself squared away, learn the lay o' the land, and come back to me whenever you need training. I'll be here night or day.

This land is grown' more dangerous, and as ye meet other folk, I think ye'll find they all have problems they could use some help with--help a skilled $c can give 'em. Good luck.
92479-complete.title: A Scribbled Letter

92479-progress.name: Tordrin Sternblade
92479-progress.text:
Ah, ye got me letter, $N... good.

Time was when ye'd not catch a $r dead wit' a bow in their hand--no more, I guess. It's good for Stormwind, but bad for the kobolds and man eatin' beasts in the area.
92479-progress.title: A Scribbled Letter

92481-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92481-accept.text: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident $c trainer--Dorii Brightwhisper--left this recall crystal for you. It contains some sort of message for you, so give it a look. Afterwards, you can find Dorii in the structure just behind me.
92481-accept.title: A Student of the Arcane

92481-complete.name: Dorii Brightwhisper
92481-complete.text:
Let me have a look at you. Yes, I believe you will make a fine young $c. The power of the arcane has waned amongst our people, but there are those who would seek to rediscover much of what we've lost in the millennia we've spent here amongst the clouds. I am sure that you will lead the charge in this never ending search for arcane knowledge, and ultimately make us proud.

Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.
92481-complete.title: A Student of the Arcane

92481-progress.name: Dorii Brightwhisper
92481-progress.text: Greetings, $N. I'm pleased to have the privilege of furthering your magical studies.
92481-progress.title: A Student of the Arcane

92482-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92482-accept.text: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident $c trainer--Tai'ree Farsight--left this note for you. You can find her just over yonder near the center of the village. Read the note then seek her out.
92482-accept.title: The Way of the Hunter

92482-complete.name: Tai'ree Farsight
92482-complete.text:
The way of the $c is fraught with danger, and only those with the keenest senses and quickest reflexes can thrive in the wilds. I look at you and I am reminded of myself when I stood before my mentor, so many years ago. I believe that you have what it takes, but in the end that is up to you alone.

Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.
92482-complete.title: The Way of the Hunter

92485-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92485-accept.text:
While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident $c trainer--Xyton Silverwind--left this note for you. Read it as soon as you can, and then seek out Silverwind on the ground floor of this great tree just behind me.

Heed his words and his counsel, he can teach you much.
92485-accept.title: A Student of Nature

92485-complete.name: Xyton Silverwind
92485-complete.text:
The flora and fauna of Zephras Isle represent a rich tapestry of vibrant life. The ecosystem requires constant balance to maintain the harmony of nature, and we druids are the keepers of that balance. I see much potential in you, but this path is not an easy one, and you will need guidance as you grow in strength as a student of the fang, the claw, the feather, and the branch. 

Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.
92485-complete.title: A Student of Nature

92485-progress.name: Xyton Silverwind
92485-progress.text: Greetings, I am Xyton Silverwind, keeper of druidic lore.
92485-progress.title: A Student of Nature

92514-accept.name: Constable Aonda
92514-accept.text:
You've got that "Windshaper" air about you. Something about how I can feel a tiny bit of static on my skin when near someone spirit-touched that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident Windshaper elder, Illaya Amberwind. She's just outside, near the center of town.

Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.
92514-accept.title: Welcome to Shen'dar Village

92514-complete.name: Constable Aonda
92514-complete.text:
Checked in with Illaya then? Great. Lots of tension between the High Order and the Windshapers these days, but they keep things civil here in Shen'dar. Everyone here is well aware that we've got bigger problems than their quibbles.

Now that that's done, you look like someone who might be looking for something to do with their hands and I've got a bandit problem that I was hoping you could help me with.
92514-complete.title: Welcome to Shen'dar Village

92515-accept.name: Indari Sunseam
92515-accept.text:
As if bandits and mad cultists weren't enough, the hills are thick with prideclaws as well right now. They are starting to encroach on the village borders and growing bolder by the day. It's only a matter of time before someone's pet or child is taken. It would be a mercy for us to cull their numbers now rather than after some tragedy occurs.

Bring me a dozen or so of their pelts. I can turn them into all sorts of goods that will be of aid to the village.
92515-accept.title: The Problem With Prideclaws

92515-complete.name: Indari Sunseam
92515-complete.text: I didn't say it wouldn't be a dirty job, did I?
92515-complete.title: The Problem With Prideclaws

92515-progress.name: Indari Sunseam
92515-progress.text: If you ask me, I think Prideclaws are actually kind of cute. From a safe distance... and while standing behind someone holding a sword, of course.
92515-progress.title: The Problem With Prideclaws

92516-accept.name: Teeri Wellwind
92516-accept.text: A flock of Hippogryph have recently established nesting grounds southeast of Shen'dar Village and they've been wreaking havoc on travelers on the road. I need someone to head down there and thin them out for us.
92516-accept.title: Hippogryph Harrassment

92516-complete.name: Teeri Wellwind
92516-complete.text: Well done, and quickly too. Not too bad at all.
92516-complete.title: Hippogryph Harrassment

92517-accept.name: Constable Aonda
92517-accept.text:
There's a cave not far to the north, hidden behind a waterfall. It's well known to me that there's a group of bandits that are operating out of that cave. They were a problem for us before the cult arrived, but now they are a real terror. I can't spare the people to go and clear them out, unfortunately.

I need you to go there and take care of them for me. Kill as many as you can, and if possible, take out their leader, the one they call "Badwind" Bennic. That cave is dangerous, so be careful.
92517-accept.title: The Criminal Element

92517-complete.name: Constable Aonda
92517-complete.text:
With the bandits dispersed, that is one less problem for us to deal with. Though I confess that now I worry that any bandits who survived may turn next to the cult for protection, further bolstering their increasingly alarming numbers.

Still though, we'll take the victories where we can get them.
92517-complete.title: The Criminal Element

92528-accept.name: Missionary Jasaan
92528-accept.text:
The faithful of Al'Akir grow ever stronger with each eager new recruit like yourself. As you can see, our strength gives form to the storm itself!

Normally I'd send you straight to Skypriest Aanders for assessment, but he is occupied at present receiving a guest at the inn on the north side of town. Please avoid that place for now. An unshaven recruit like yourself in the presence of such a guest would be inappropriate.

For now, just don't get in anyone's way.
92528-accept.title: Among the Faithful

92528-complete.name: Constable Aonda
92528-complete.text:
Lorthuna herself was there? She's the leader of the whole damned cult!

If they are making a move on Shen'dar Village and the western watchtower, we've got to be ready. What is strange is... why the watchtower?

The Village I can understand, but the tower? It doesn't have much strategic significance, other than as a minor lookout post.

Regardless, we will be prepared for them. They'll find that highlanders aren't as easy to catch flat footed as they might think.
92528-complete.title: Among the Faithful

92529-accept.name: Sania Silverstream
92529-accept.text:
It gladdens my heart that you wish to serve Al'Akir. Our current trials as a people stem from our own complacency. We grew prideful and took the bounty of the winds for granted. The stagnation that followed is the reason the spirits of the wind abandoned us.

Only through acts of contrition may we feel the wind's caress once more. If you seek the fellowship of like-minded shen'dorei, go to Falaath Village and find Missionary Jasaan there. I will mark you so that the faithful will know you as a recruit.
92529-accept.title: Falaath Village

92529-complete.name: Missionary Jasaan
92529-complete.text:
What is this? A new acolyte seeking to serve the windlord sent by sister Sania? Truly we are blessed by the touch of the four winds this day!

We welcome all who seek to bask in the blessings of Al'Akir.
92529-complete.title: Falaath Village

92544-accept.name: Hanaa Nightwind
92544-accept.text:
A band of Al'Aketh cult ruffians have taken up residence near the temple ruins just southwest of here, led by a real monster called Malduko Cloudcrush. This rabble has no doubt been dispatched here by High Priestess Lorthuna at the Shrine of Akir to attack travelers and coerce our people into joining the cult.

I need to stay here at my post to alert travelers leaving the grove of the danger, but I would be grateful if you could do something about those cultists and their leader for me.
92544-accept.title: Al'Aketh Thugs

92544-complete.name: Hanaa Nightwind
92544-complete.text:
It was all I could do to stop myself from going over and joining you from my position here. I can only hope that these louts got the message and clear out of here soon. 

Thank you, $c. You have the gratitude of the Rangers of Thendal Grove.
92544-complete.title: Al'Aketh Thugs

92550-accept.name: Constable Aonda
92550-accept.text:
Our best defense here might just be a strong offense. The advantage we now have is that we expect an attack is coming. What they won't expect is for us to hit them first.

I've already asked a lot of you, but please head back over to Falaath Village. Kill as many cultists as you can and if you can get close enough, kill the commander and bring me his head. I'll stay here and organize the citizens and our few peacekeepers to prepare a defense... just in case you don't return.
92550-accept.title: Havoc in the Highlands

92550-complete.name: Constable Aonda
92550-complete.text:
Thank the winds you've returned!

Sania Silverstream snuck out of town just before you returned, no doubt fleeing at the sight of our people arming themselves.

You've done an incredible thing for the people of Shen'dar Village and we owe you a debt of gratitude. If the cult returns to the highlands, they will find that Shen'dar is not such an easy target.

Winds guide you, $N.
92550-complete.title: Havoc in the Highlands

92550-progress.name: Constable Aonda
92550-progress.text: It feels good to turn the tables on these zealots.
92550-progress.title: Havoc in the Highlands

92551-accept.name: Danarii Bellowveil
92551-accept.text:
I overheard you might be going to Falaath Village? While you are there, please keep an eye out for our stolen supply caches.

The Al'Aketh have been raiding our supply caravans carrying various goods such as food and windstones to and from the lowlands for months. They've been blaming the bandits, of course, but we all know that it all ends up in the same place. If there's any of that stuff left in Falaath, it would be a huge help if you could recover it.
92551-accept.title: Stolen Supplies

92551-complete.name: Danarii Bellowveil
92551-complete.text: This is great! We've been barely squeaking by without our regular supply deliveries. I'll work with the constable to ensure that these supplies get redistributed to the townsfolk who are in most dire need.
92551-complete.title: Stolen Supplies

92551-progress.name: Danarii Bellowveil
92551-progress.text: There's a lot of hungry and desperate $r here who need these supplies.
92551-progress.title: Stolen Supplies

92553-accept.name: Zerril Softbreeze
92553-accept.text:
Up for a bit of work? I could use a bit of muscle from a strong adventuring-type such as yourself. With how dangerous things are getting around here, no one's had much time to hunt or forage of late, and I need someone to get out there and source me fresh eggs and strider meat to keep this village fed.

I'd be happy to teach you one of my famous recipes if you can bring me what I need. What do you say?
92553-accept.title: Restocking the Larders

92553-complete.name: Zerril Softbreeze
92553-complete.text:
These eggs aren't easy to get but wind save me, they are DELICIOUS fried up in a bit of ursera tallow.

If you've got a bit of time to spare and you enjoy cooking, I can teach you a few tips and tricks I've picked up. Say the word and I'd be happy to train you.
92553-complete.title: Restocking the Larders

92553-progress.name: Zerril Softbreeze
92553-progress.text: No matter how much things change here on Zephras and how uncertain things get, I always say that a pipe full of dried peacebloom and nice full belly is a comfort that can't be beat!
92553-progress.title: Restocking the Larders

92579-accept.name: Constable Aonda
92579-accept.text:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to the Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.

The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight.

At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, $N.
92579-accept.title: To Valanaar

92579-complete.name: Valennia Stormfist
92579-complete.text:
<Valennia's expression darkens as she reads the letter.>

Aonda trusted you to deliver this and she speaks highly enough of you in this letter, so I'll try to trust you too. Before we speak further, I need to consult with the few peacekeepers we have left here and formulate a plan in case the cult strikes here next. Enjoy your stay in Valanaar for now.

If you are looking to keep yourself busy, there are plenty of townsfolk that can likely use the help of a strong young adventurer like yourself.
92579-complete.title: To Valanaar

92579-progress.name: Valennia Stormfist
92579-progress.text: A letter from Aonda. What's that crafty highlander been up to?
92579-progress.title: To Valanaar

92595-accept.name: Illaya Amberwind
92595-accept.text:
<Illaya smiles warmly at you.>

I am glad you returned to speak with me, child of the winds. I knew it the first moment you walked into my presence, that you were strong in the skysight. Do you find this surprising? Even those who have not trained as a Shaman may possess the gift. 

Come, let us speak about the mandate of the Windshapers, the nature of our struggles on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
92595-accept.title: The Windshapers

92595-complete.name: Illaya Amberwind
92595-complete.text:
I think you now understand how important the mission of the Windshapers is. Every soul who commands the skysight is of vital importance if we hope to establish dialogue with the spirits of the winds once again.

Between threats from within such as the Al'Aketh, and the uncertainty of our safety here in Skywall, it is our responsibility as Windshapers to use our gifts to save our home and ensure that the Shen'dorei can survive these trying times.
92595-complete.title: The Windshapers

92596-accept.name: Rathiril Sunlance
92596-accept.text:
The aura of arcane energy that surrounds you is strong, even though you are not initiated as a mage. I am quite sure that you are going to be a capable adventurer, and your connection with our ancient magic will only ever be a boon to you even if you were to never utter a single word of power in spellcasting.

Come, let us sit and speak some on my order, the nature of the arcane here on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
92596-accept.title: The High Order

92596-complete.name: Rathiril Sunlance
92596-complete.text:
The High Order's mission is vital to the survival of our people. We hold our elemental benefactors in the utmost regard, but we must face reality; they are gone now, and we are on our own.

Between threats from within such as the Al'Aketh, and uncertainties of our security on this plane, it is our destiny as Highborne descendants of our ancestral home of Eldre'Thalas to use our gifts to ensure that the shen'dorei can stand on our own once again.
92596-complete.title: The High Order

92597-accept.name: Falorne Fallwind
92597-accept.text:
Here in the elemental plane, we derive much of our arcane strength from ley lines that still run through the ground under our feet. Of late, these ley lines have begun to pierce the surface, giving us more direct and powerful access to these latent arcane energies.

Go to the standing stones to the northeast. There is a ley line there. Tap into your birthright and draw in its energy.
92597-accept.title: Reading the Ley Lines

92597-complete.name: Falorne Fallwind
92597-complete.text:
Do you feel it? Yes? Good! You have taken your first steps. You'll find that with your abilities, you will be able to tap into latent magical energy in many locations. Doing so will provide a myriad of benefits, some profound, others more subtle. You won't know until you tap into them, But that's the best part of the gift... making the unknown known.

If we are to survive these dire times, we must be unwavering in our search for knowledge... and power.
92597-complete.title: Reading the Ley Lines

92597-progress.name: Falorne Fallwind
92597-progress.text: Realizing our true potential as sons and daughters of the highborne is our only path to salvation. The Windshapers are little better than the Al'Aketh, supplicating themselves to uncaring, otherworldly creatures.
92597-progress.title: Reading the Ley Lines

92598-accept.name: Ventaari Brightwish
92598-accept.text:
As a Windshaper, you have the ability to use the sacred skysight gifted to us by the elemental spirits. Travel to the standing stones to the northeast of the village. Find the elemental convergence there and use your gift.

You'll find that you may draw upon the skysight anywhere, but its boon is much more powerful if you do so in the presence of an elemental convergence. You may at times receive other bits of wisdom from the spirits that are drawn to such places of power, as well.
92598-accept.title: The Gift of Skysight

92598-complete.name: Ventaari Brightwish
92598-complete.text:
Like a muscle, your skysight must be exercised if you hope to grow stronger in the gift. Leveraging your skysight to bridge the distance between the mortal and the spiritual may prove invaluable to you in your adventures.

You'd do well to remember what you've learned here today. Our ability to use our gifts to hear what the elements tell us could be the key to our survival.
92598-complete.title: The Gift of Skysight

926-complete.name: Flawed Power Stones
926-complete.text: These stones are infused with magical energy, but purposefully flawed.  They are very unstable and once removed from the table they will consume themselves quickly.
926-complete.title: Flawed Power Stone

92640-accept.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
92640-accept.text:
Since engaging the cult in the open is not viable, our best chance is going to be to use this opportunity to attack the shrine itself. We can take Lorthuna herself off the board before she can finish her part of this scheme.

It so happens that Valennia has been preparing a strategy for a potential assault on the Shrine for some time now. The only problem is, we will need help. 

Speak with Valennia for the details.
92640-accept.title: Desperate Times

92640-complete.name: Valennia Stormfist
92640-complete.text: Tensions between the Windshapers and High Order are high right now, but we couldn't hope to carry out this plan without both groups on board.
92640-complete.title: Desperate Times

92642-accept.name: Yorana Windyreed
92642-accept.text:
Valennia only sent one person to help repel a full-scale assault... by the winds.

You don't look like much but I'll take what I can get. We need to inflict as much damage as possible to stop this soon. My people can't hold out much longer.

Go down the hill and disrupt their logistics. Their healers are keeping the attackers coming, if we take them out we might be able to rally and push them back. Any other cultists you kill while you are out there are helpful as well.
92642-accept.title: Disrupting Logistics

92642-complete.name: Yorana Windyreed
92642-complete.text: You are still alive? Thank the winds for small miracles, I suppose.
92642-complete.title: Disrupting Logistics

92643-accept.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
92643-accept.text:
