There you have it, you can now craft your very own Lodestone. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97970-complete.title: Camping 101: Mining

97971-accept.name: Raan Wildwind
97971-accept.text:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
97971-accept.title: Camping 101: Skinning

97971-complete.name: Mendalass Tattermend
97971-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97971-complete.title: Camping 101: Skinning

97973-accept.name: Raan Wildwind
97973-accept.text:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
97973-accept.title: Camping 101: Tailoring

97977-accept.name: Tarindrella
97977-accept.text:
The Gnarlpine furbolg would not turn on their ancient allies so readily. We must learn more of their plight.

Search their abandoned homes for totems. If any survived the chaos of their departure, their engravings may tell us more of what happened here.

You'll find their camps along the western edge of the glen, though the grell and grellkin may have scattered them beyond.
97977-accept.title: Nature's Call

97977-complete.name: Tarindrella
97977-complete.text:
Oh, it's even worse than I thought.

These engravings tell us that the Gnarlpine began having nightmares of being wiped out by some great shadow. Before long, that fear turned to rage--and the shadow to their former elven friends. To be aware of your own mind slipping away from you...

Our only hope is that this may help us better understand what is happening on Teldrassil. Thank you for your aid, $N.
97977-complete.title: Nature's Call

97977-progress.name: Tarindrella
97977-progress.text: Don't worry about any larger totems you might find. I wouldn't know what to do with them if you found a way to get them!
97977-progress.title: Nature's Call

97979-accept.name: Shanda
97979-accept.text:
You are born kaldorei--the children of the stars--and have inherited a birthright unlike any other in this world. Elune's grace may illuminate our strengths, helping our strikes hit true, or it may help conceal us just as the moon may eclipse the sun.

Our Long Vigil after the defense of Mount Hyjal has ended, and we have joined an Alliance of others--which you will meet in due time. For now, you are nestled in the boughs of Teldrassil.

Demonstrate Mother Moon's gifts, and bask in her blessings.
97979-accept.title: The Goddess Provides

97979-complete.name: Shanda
97979-complete.text: You have seen what our goddess provides. Use it well, and she will never forsake you.
97979-complete.title: The Goddess Provides

98024-accept.name: Thrall
98024-accept.text:
After journeying here from the elemental plane, the problems our lands face may seem small. Rest assured, the dangers the horde faces are very real, and you will grow formidable should you survive your service.

If you'd like to get started doing some good in our world, travel southwest to the vast lands known as the Barrens. There is a settlement there known as the Crossroads. The proud citizens there are ever in need of aid.

Go with honor, adventurer!
98024-accept.title: Journey to the Crossroads

98024-complete.name: Thork
98024-complete.text:
What's this? An elf? And you say the Warchief sent you?

<Thork grunts sharply as he looks you up and down.>

You look a little skinny to me, but it matters not. Out here you'll either thrive and survive, or you'll die. That is the way of things in these lands.
98024-complete.title: Journey to the Crossroads

98025-accept.name: Unknown
98025-accept.text:
Attention!

A reward is being offered for the death of the owl "Jai'vhanel" also know as "Swordfeather".

Unfortunately this owl has gone mad and has begun to attack travelers as they journey along the road near Auberdine.

Jai'vhanel was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Bring back one of her jet black feathers as proof of her death.

Reward claims for this bounty should be claimed with Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

The Auberdine Village Council
98025-accept.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel

98025-complete.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
98025-complete.text:
It is good to know that issue has been taken care of, but it saddens me that we could not find another way. Jai'vhanel had been somewhat of a guardian of this area for quite some time, and I am not sure what could have caused her decent into madness.

Regardless, thank you for your service today, $c. The roads to Auberdine are safe for travel once again.
98025-complete.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel

98025-progress.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
98025-progress.text: Greetings $c - what may the Sentinels assist you with today? Perhaps you are here to inquire about the bounty on Jai'vhanel?
98025-progress.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel

98042-accept.name: Jec
98042-accept.text:
<As you tear away the single page from the Twilight Tome, a foreboding voice floods your mind, uninvited.>

They have failed.

You will be forgotten.

They will lose the eye they gained.
98042-accept.title: It's All Fun and Games Until...

98046-accept.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
98046-accept.text:
<Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm's gaze narrows.>

You're still here?

Take the phial and get out of my sight, $c. It is clear my answers do not lie in the waters, just as they did not before. 

Perhaps one of the priestesses in the Temple of the Moon to the south will dispose of it.

<Fandral looks away, no longer speaking to you.>

I must look elsewhere if this is to work...
98046-accept.title: Crown of the Earth

98046-complete.name: Lariia
98046-complete.text:
Do not mind the Arch Druid, $N. He bears the weight of much in Malfurion's absence.

Wait! Some drops yet remain in the phial! Perhaps that is why his incantation failed?
98046-complete.title: Crown of the Earth

98065-accept.name: Lariia
98065-accept.text:
You must bring this to Tyrande at once! I will transfer it to a more ceremonial container for you.

Do not be afraid. The High Priestess of Elune is firm, but kind. She protects all who enter Darnassus, and carries our goddess' light to all.

She will be glad to receive this sacred water. You will find her directly above us.
98065-accept.title: Crown of the Earth

98065-complete.name: Tyrande Whisperwind
98065-complete.text:
Staghelm has done much in my beloved's absence, but he is not Malfurion. And he does not run the affairs of Darnassus--that burden is mine alone.

<Tyrande's face settles.>

I apologize. As you have likely seen, we have many challenges to overcome.

Fandral is Arch Druid for now, and I ask you respect his station. But his doings pertain to druidism, and mine not only to Elune but indeed to lead our people as she wills.

Every drop of this water is blessed by our goddess. I thank you for saving it.
98065-complete.title: Crown of the Earth

98065-progress.name: Tyrande Whisperwind
98065-progress.text: Please state your business. I have a city to run, and a people to lead.
98065-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

98067-accept.name: Sentinel Dalia Sunblade
98067-accept.text:
General Feathermoon ensures all sentinels have time to pray to Elune. A proper huntress wields not blade alone, but gifts of the goddess to overcome our enemies.

You may help with my daily duties. Place sentinels around the city--start with the tunnels leading beneath Cenarion Hold to the north, the bank at the center of town, the inn in the Craftsman's Terrace to the northeast, and the city gates. The guards can assist you.

Something is amiss in Teldrassil--we must remain vigilant.
98067-accept.title: Eyes of the Sentinels

98067-complete.name: Sentinel Dalia Sunblade
98067-complete.text: I thank you for your aid. Though I find peace in the daily rituals, it is nice to have a moment to reflect instead.
98067-complete.title: Eyes of the Sentinels

982-accept.name: Gorbold Steelhand
982-accept.text:
Off the coast of Darkshore to our north are two wrecked ships - the Silver Dawning and the Mist Veil. Some time ago, both ships ran afoul of the blasted murlocs as they sailed across the vast sea into Auberdine. They now lie at the bottom of the ocean as trophies for those fiends.

Both captains didn't make it out that night, and their logs and other effects are still below in lockboxes. I'd like for you to recover them for us; it would mean a lot to the crew members still around these parts.
982-accept.title: Deep Ocean, Vast Sea

982-progress.name: Gorbold Steelhand
982-progress.text: The captains of those ships were good night elves, and they deserve a better fate than they were given. Perhaps tending to their personal effects will be the best way to put their spirits to rest.
982-progress.title: Deep Ocean, Vast Sea

98247-accept.name: Unknown
98247-accept.text:
<A torn shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain.

"Property of the Azeroth Commerce Authority. Please return empty crates or unfulfilled shipments to our local trade hub at the Three Corners crossroads in Redridge Mountains. Couriers will be compensated for their time and travel."

Beside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.>
98247-accept.title: Shipping Label

98247-complete.name: Marcy Baker
98247-complete.text:
You have arrived at the right place! I am happy to mark you down as one of our affiliates. No contracts to sign and no commitments to weigh you down. All we ask of you is your diligence to assist in completing or returning any of our deliveries you find on your travels.

When you do so, you will be compensated with Merchant's Favor that will allow you to purchase goods and services we offer here. In fact, here's a little bit to get you started.

Now, do you happen to have the crate this came from?
98247-complete.title: Shipping Label

98247-progress.name: Marcy Baker
98247-progress.text: Ah, greetings! How can I be of assistance?
98247-progress.title: Shipping Label

98284-accept.name: Raan Wildwind
98284-accept.text:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
98284-accept.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

983-accept.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
983-accept.text:
Hey! Help me with my latest invention, the buzzbox. You can talk to people far away!

Maybe you've already seen them, they're boxes with levers on them. The only problem is they need constant maintenance.

Each one suffers from a different problem, but I made a really smart decision. I placed each one near creatures that have the proper parts to fix that particular machine. Right now Buzzbox 827 is on the fritz. It's just south of Auberdine, real close. It takes 6 Crawler Legs to fix it. I'll pay ya...
983-accept.title: Buzzbox 827

983-progress.name: Buzzbox 827
983-progress.text: Buzzbox 827 sits with an eerie silence. A single flashing light indicates that it needs 6 Crawler Legs to be placed in its holding box.
983-progress.title: Buzzbox 827

98319-accept.name: Mountaineer Gretchen
98319-accept.text:
It's bad enough havin' a troll problem, but the mountains are filled tae the brim with wendigos! They normally keep to their own caves, but they seem tae be spreadin' like bunnies. Now they've filled the Grizzled Den north of here.

If we want Whitebeard's report, we're gonna need to find my partner Cornelius. The blockhead got a little too excited and charged in head first. Brave, but stupid.

Head into the cave and see where he is. And feel free to take out some the beasts while yer at it.
98319-accept.title: Secure the Mountain

98319-complete.name: Mountaineer Gretchen
98319-complete.text:
Ach, the fool...

Thank ye for the help, $N. Guess we have our report.
98319-complete.title: Secure the Mountain

98321-accept.name: Tognus Flintfire
98321-accept.text:
Hoha! Good to see a $r who's not afraid to get their hands dirty.

If yer lookin' fer work, I'm afraid I'm a little short on supplies at the moment. Our most reliable source of ore has been overrun by wendigo and now the cave has been abandoned. The miners had to drop everything when they fled!

Say, why don't ye poke yer head around the Grizzled Den to the west and see if you can find some of our missing shipments. It would save us a great deal o' trouble.
98321-accept.title: Flintfire's Shipment

98321-complete.name: Tognus Flintfire
98321-complete.text: Now that's more like it! With these shipments we'll get the forge back up and runnin' in no time!
98321-complete.title: Flintfire's Shipment

98321-progress.name: Tognus Flintfire
98321-progress.text: Wendigos are nasty beasties. Its just good all the miners made it out of the Grizzled Den in one piece!
98321-progress.title: Flintfire's Shipment

98322-accept.name: Senir Whitebeard
98322-accept.text:
Spelunking dark caves is adventurer business. My job's just to make reports and send them over to Ironforge.

Trouble is, one of my reports hasn't... well, reported back. I asked a few mountaineers to learn more about the wendigo problem we have out here, but I haven't heard from them.

If you're already going to be out and about, what say you don't check in with Mountaineer Gretchen just west of town. I'm late enough as it is!
98322-accept.title: Secure the Mountain

98322-complete.name: Mountaineer Gretchen
98322-complete.text:
Ol' Whitebeard sent ya, aye?

I got his report, alright. This whole situation's a mess!
98322-complete.title: Secure the Mountain

98323-accept.name: Mountaineer Gretchen
98323-accept.text:
Hopefully ye put down a fair number of the mongrels while you were in there. Shame about Cornelius, though.

From what you described, there's not much to report other than the cave is a lost cause. Whitebeard's not gonna like that answer, but I'm not darin' sendin' anybody else into that death trap.

Feel free tae pass along the message, $N. I'm not leavin' this spot till the mountain's secure.
98323-accept.title: Secure the Mountain

98323-complete.name: Senir Whitebeard
98323-complete.text:
Completely overrun? Why am I not surprised.

Well, that's going in the report too.

<Senir folds Gretchen's letter into his pile of notes>
98323-complete.title: Secure the Mountain

98323-progress.name: Senir Whitebeard
98323-progress.text:
Ah, you're back just in time.

What's the matter, $g lad:lass;? You look like you've seen a ghost.
98323-progress.title: Secure the Mountain

98326-accept.name: Gretta Ganter
98326-accept.text:
Do ye know how hard it is to fish on a frozen lake? My poor husband, Paxton, has been out in the middle of it for days and we barely have a single sack to show fer it.

Well, we DID have a sack to show fer it. Until the thrice-damned wendigo attacked me and made off with our haul. It'll take us weeks to fish all that back up! If that loudmouth Frosthowl didn't scare 'em all off, anyway.

Do us a favor and get it back, aye? Drooling brute is hiding somewhere deep in the Grizzled Den to the southeast.
98326-accept.title: Frosthowl

98326-complete.name: Gretta Ganter
98326-complete.text:
Yer a real lifesaver, $N!

My husband would just laugh it off, but I couldn't bare tellin' him he has to spend another night on the lake. Maybe now we can enjoy a real feast.
98326-complete.title: Frosthowl

98326-progress.name: Gretta Ganter
98326-progress.text: It'll be a hot day in Dun Morogh before I tell Paxton I lost his entire stockpile to a wendigo.
98326-progress.title: Frosthowl

98389-accept.name: Aramis Hammerhand
98389-accept.text:
If you remember but one thing, know this: not even death can stop the Light.

This we have in common with all Forsaken--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own fear us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.

In truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but we are not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.

Then they will see our nature.
98389-accept.title: A Light in the Darkness

98389-complete.name: Aramis Hammerhand
98389-complete.text:
May this help Executor Arren and so many others see our true nature. Much like in our past lives, we live to serve our people--to protect them with the gifts the Light provides us.

They will see in time that we are just as valuable to the Dark Lady's plans as any other.

Light be with you.
98389-complete.title: A Light in the Darkness

98391-accept.name: Laurna Morninglight
98391-accept.text:
Blessings to you, $c. The Sisterhood of Elune has stood as a pillar of kaldorei society for thousands of years.

Before the Great Sundering, before the War of the Ancients, through the Long Vigil, we have guided and healed our people through the darkness. Such is our charge, and such is the demand of the peerless Mother Moon.

We now require your aid in a matter of great importance. Sister Aquinne awaits your arrival in Darnassus.
98391-accept.title: The Sisterhood of Elune

98391-complete.name: Sister Aquinne
98391-complete.text: I am glad you arrived so quickly. The Sisterhood requires your aid.
98391-complete.title: The Sisterhood of Elune

98392-accept.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
98392-accept.text:
These belts... look closely at the leather, $N. Do you see the taint running through the fibers?

I have a suspicion as to its origin, but we will need further proof to be sure.

Venture back out into the harpies' nests to the west and take out their leaders. If their necklaces carry the same darkness as these belts, we'll have our answer.
98392-accept.title: Darkness in the Glade

98392-complete.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
98392-complete.text:
<Arynia investigates the amulets.>

Do you see the foul green swirls within the gems? This is indeed fel moss corruption at work.

I have heard similar reports from Shadowglen and elsewhere in the boughs of this substance turning our very world against us.

I will inform my superiors of this at once.
98392-complete.title: Darkness in the Glade

98392-progress.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
98392-progress.text: Have you wrested the amulets from the harpies' leaders?
98392-progress.title: Darkness in the Glade

98398-accept.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
98398-accept.text:
I am impressed by what you have accomplished here in so short a time, $N. Would that I could ask you to remain here to assist me with my duties... but I know in my heart that greater tasks lie ahead for you.

I have noticed the Oracle Tree has just shed a piece of its bark. No doubt it has a task that it wishes completed. You should speak with it.
98398-accept.title: The Oracle Tree

98398-complete.name: Unknown
98398-complete.text: As you inspect the fallen bark, a voice enters your mind. It is calm and soothing, cresting over you like a gentle breeze through the leaves.
98398-complete.title: The Oracle Tree

984-accept.name: Terenthis
984-accept.text:
Some of my brethren were rescued from a corrupt furbolg in Teldrassil, and I've vowed to stop any more atrocities before more of our kind are injured... or worse.

I have seen a couple hints of corruption in Darkshore already, but I have yet to find any widespread signs. I think it would be logical if the investigation continued with the furbolgs. Would you find one of their camps, and return to me if you see any signs of corruption?
984-accept.title: How Big a Threat?

984-complete.name: Terenthis
984-complete.text:
This is terrible news indeed, $N.

With the furbolgs this close to Auberdine, we will have to prepare ourselves for the inevitable.

Thank you, $N.
984-complete.title: How Big a Threat?

98403-accept.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
98403-accept.text:
Lord Melenas did not act alone; he was at the behest of another. The one you seek is Xethorr the Wicked. It seems he has twisted the spiders that call Teldrassil home, intending their venom for some foul plan.

He has taken residence deep in the forest, in the area to the northwest of here known as the Cleft. Take caution, and bring allies, for Xethorr is not an opponent to be trifled with.

Dispatch his brood, and bring me anything that may tell us more of the satyr's work here.
98403-accept.title: Twisted Hatred

98403-complete.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
98403-complete.text:
I should have known this was being used to twist the spiders of this land.

I have heard whispers of this substance being the source of much of the corruption plaguing us. Though this is not the original, it is an older sample and may yield more information than what we have obtained so far.

Normally I would have you send this to Darnassus for further study. However, it is best we kept this quiet for the moment, or Dolanaar will never recover its reputation.

I trust you to do the same.
98403-complete.title: Twisted Hatred

98403-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
98403-progress.text:
<Tallonkai lowers his voice.>

Does Xethorr still walk freely?
98403-progress.title: Twisted Hatred

98407-accept.name: Deputy Feldon
98407-accept.text:
If the gnolls are growing so bold they are willing to camp this close to humans, there's no telling how much further they'll go. We need to deter them.

The beasts are hardly organized, but they seem to respect strength above all else. If we can slay the worst of them, maybe claim some of their trophies, we can remind these gnolls why they should stay in the hills where they belong.

Should you see any of their thrashers, bring me their collars. That should put the fear of the Alliance back into them.
98407-accept.title: Show of Force

98423-accept.name: Unknown
98423-accept.text: Inside of the vault you find a tablet detailing the terms of a peace treaty between the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer dwarf clans. It appears to date back to time period just after of the War of the Three Hammers, and is very likely a notable piece of dwarven history. The king of Ironforge would no doubt be interested in this artifact.
98423-accept.title: The Treaty of Understanding

98423-complete.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
98423-complete.text:
Ah yes, my ancestor Madoran was the first Bronzebeard king of Ironforge following the great civil war between the Wildhammer, Bronzebeard, and Dark Iron clans. This treaty was drafted to codify the cessation of hostilities and terms of peace after the Bronzebeards won the mountain.

As you can see, the Wildhammers and Bronzebeards signed it... and the Dark Irons did not.

Thank you for recovering this and bringing it to me, $c.
98423-complete.title: The Treaty of Understanding

98423-progress.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
98423-progress.text: What have you brought from the depths, $c.
98423-progress.title: The Treaty of Understanding

98424-accept.name: Unknown
98424-accept.text:
Some particularly worn papers are held separately, folded in Fizsprocket's inside breast pocket.

They seem to detail important information that could be used against the Venture Co. and its operations in the region. It would be prudent to look for more before returning to Morin Cloudstalker.
98424-accept.title: Fizsprocket's Notes

98461-accept.name: Archaeologist Hollee
98461-accept.text:
If you're heading out of Auberdine, I could use your help!

My dear friend Tarrel and I were classmates in school. Oh, he was such a quickfire on all things excavation! We got split up after graduation--him to Wetlands, and me to here in Darkshore.

<Hollee sighs, then her brow furrows slightly.>

Sorry, and his wife... Merrin.

It doesn't matter. If you go to the Wetlands, could you make sure he's alright? And maybe give him this? He's probably near Menethil Harbor. There's a boat straight there.
98461-accept.title: Unrequited Love

985-accept.name: Terenthis
985-accept.text:
You've already proven adept at scouting our enemy, $N. Do you have what it takes to fight them as well?

Not all adventurers prefer straightforward combat to the art of stealth and evasion.

If you think you're up for the task, then the furbolg camp south of Auberdine is currently the biggest threat to our people. You'll find some of the Blackwood tribe there. Kill 8 pathfinders and 5 windtalkers, and return to me here.
985-accept.title: How Big a Threat?

98512-accept.name: Fendaal Windstone
98512-accept.text:
You there, stranger. Get low and keep quiet. We are not alone here.

I was on patrol near the border and noticed that there are a number of Al'Aketh skulking around the house just up the hill there to the north. I don't know what they are doing here, but it can't be good.

If you want to make yourself useful, get in there and take them out. I'll wait here and watch your back.
98512-accept.title: Al'Aketh Assassins

98512-complete.name: Fendaal Windstone
98512-complete.text:
I'm glad you made it back. That group of Al'Aketh looked like stone cold killers. 

Thank you for your aid, I'll include your assistance in my report when I return to Valanaar.
98512-complete.title: Al'Aketh Assassins

98545-accept.name: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered
98545-accept.text:
Since you are here, I'd like you to deliver this letter to an old friend of mine in the Undercity. I'd deliver myself but I have a somewhat colorful history with the Dark Lady, and it would be better if a neutral third party made the delivery.

You are looking for a goblin named Glix Xizzix in the Trade Quarter area of the Undercity. I'm sure he'd be happy to compensate you for your time.

<Leonid lets out a low chuckle as he hands you the letter.>
98545-accept.title: Leonid's Letter

98545-complete.name: Glix Xizzix
98545-complete.text:
Thanks for delivering this, pal.

Wait... he said I'd tip you? I didn't agree to that! 

Fine. Take your pick of this junk in the lost and found. You'd be surprised how many of these Forsaken leave their stuff laying around after getting haircuts. There's a joke here about them being brainless, but I suspect in a lot of cases it might actually be true.
98545-complete.title: Leonid's Letter

98545-progress.name: Glix Xizzix
98545-progress.text: What's that? You say that Leonid sent you? Oh boy, haven't seen that crusty old soldier since Naxxramas was raining hell down on our heads.
98545-progress.title: Leonid's Letter

98575-accept.name: Gornek
98575-accept.text:
Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, $N.

I usually avoid dealing with warlocks if I can help it, but I think you should read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from your newly-appointed trainer, Nartok. He would have words with you when you're ready.
98575-accept.title: Tainted Tablet

98575-complete.name: Nartok
98575-complete.text:
You have just glimpsed the power that can be yours. The feeble and foolish among us are afraid of the path that we tread, but with boldness and cunning we can decide our own fates.

Guard your powers closely. The fearful lash out against that which they do not understand.

Now you are one of us. If you need training in spells then return to me.
98575-complete.title: Tainted Tablet

98575-progress.name: Nartok
98575-progress.text: Ah, you received my message. Excellent. We orcs have a long and turbulent history with the entities of the Nether, but now we forge our own path, in command of our destiny. You, too, can seize the power to shape the future for your people. Where our leaders falter, we are ready to press forward and claim our rightful place. You will be of eminence among the trolls.
98575-progress.title: Tainted Tablet

98576-accept.name: Gornek
98576-accept.text:
Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, $N.

Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the mage trainer Mai'ah. She would have words with you when you're ready.
98576-accept.title: Glyphic Parchment

98576-complete.name: Mai'ah
98576-complete.text:
Da magic dat flows through you be da greatest power in da universe, but ya must be patient. Wait for da perfect moment to strike. Choose da right response to da problem at hand. If you be smart, and you watch carefully, dere be nothing you can't do.

When ya tink you be ready for trainin', come back to Mai'ah. She teach you what you ready to learn, no problem.
98576-complete.title: Glyphic Parchment

98576-progress.name: Mai'ah
98576-progress.text: Ya come to Mai'ah ready to learn. Dat be good. Ya got da power to touch da strands of da cosmos, but ya also got da wisdom to know dat you need guidance. I can teach ya da first steps to wield dat power.
98576-progress.title: Glyphic Parchment

98581-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
98581-accept.text: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. Based on the Wildhammer style to these inscriptions, I'm guessin' this came from the $c trainer Teo Hammerstorm. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
98581-accept.title: Archaic Rune

98581-complete.name: Teo Hammerstorm
98581-complete.text: The shamanic arts have been kept by the Wildhammer clan for years, an' now those arts have passed into the care of the Bronzebeard dwarves as well. I'm here ta help spread these teachings an' offer guidance for new shamans learning the ways of the elements. Come ta me if ya need more trainin' in the spells of earth, air, fire, an' water.
98581-complete.title: Archaic Rune

98581-progress.name: Teo Hammerstorm
98581-progress.text: Ah, you were able to read the rune? It is imbued with the power of elements from some of our oldest script. That shows that you have the makings of a $c.
98581-progress.title: Archaic Rune

98601-accept.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
98601-accept.text:
While you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. It reeks of the light, so I imagine its of some importance to a $c like yourself.

Read it before heading out again. Just please--step away when you do. Paladins make me quite uneasy.
98601-accept.title: A Difficult Path

98601-complete.name: Aramis Hammerhand
98601-complete.text: Your training can now begin in earnest, $c. I see great promise in you, but take care not to turn away from the light, even for a moment. Embrace the pain it will cause you. That pain is a crucible, and you will emerge from it stronger than you ever were in your previous life.
98601-complete.title: A Difficult Path

99046-accept.name: Sentinel Kyra Starsong
99046-accept.text:
The Council of the Forest sent a small group of sentinels to the Oracle Tree some time ago. The tree sends messages to our elders, and it falls to us to deliver them to Darnassus safely.

I received word that our most recent runner has not yet arrived. The Oracle's messages vary in frequency, but it has been abnormally long.

Please head towards the Oracle Glade along the road to the west and check on her. It would have been Eralya Leafshadow's turn, and she is still in training. Elune guide you.
99046-accept.title: The Lost Runner

99046-complete.name: Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow
99046-complete.text: Elune's grace... I shall not die... alone...
99046-complete.title: The Lost Runner

99047-accept.name: Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow
99047-accept.text:
My sisters and I... were dispatched... Oracle Tree...

Tree... message. I... harpies... everywhere...

<Eralya coughs up blood, grimacing through the pain.>

I may not have long... no one coming. Please... Byancie... in Dolanaar...
99047-accept.title: Not Dead Yet

99047-complete.name: Byancie
99047-complete.text:
The harpies have become afflicted by the same foulness showing up throughout the forest. I'm sure that is what ails Sentinel Eralya as well.

We must hurry. It won't be long before she succumbs to her injuries.
99047-complete.title: Not Dead Yet

99048-accept.name: Orgnil Soulscar
99048-accept.text:
A member of the Shattered Hand, a group of more... subtle fighters, was watching Tiragarde Keep from a distance. Her reports suddenly stopped coming in.

I doubt the humans would have caught her, so I'm concerned something more dangerous is at play. See if you can find her. Hopefully the messages are just delayed.
99048-accept.title: A Missing Hand

99048-complete.name: Heglan Shadeeye
99048-complete.text:
Heglan's body lies cold within the wreckage of the hut.

Whatever killed her doesn't seem to be human. There may be signs of what happened nearby.
99048-complete.title: A Missing Hand

99049-accept.name: Heglan Shadeeye
99049-accept.text:
The nearby area is destroyed with obvious signs of a skirmish. Whatever ambushed Heglan didn't make it out unscathed. There's probably signs nearby of what happened.

Orgnil will probably want to see any evidence left by the attackers.
99049-accept.title: Threat from Below

99049-complete.name: Orgnil Soulscar
99049-complete.text:
This banner and blade piece belong to the naga! They must have come down the coast from the north.

We cannot let them establish a foothold here. The pressure from both directions would be too much for Razor Hill.
99049-complete.title: Threat from Below

99050-accept.name: Byancie
99050-accept.text:
I will need your help acquiring the ingredients I need to stop the affliction long enough for Eralya to make it back here for further treatment.

Thankfully, our living home is still bountiful and will provide in our time of need.

The core ingredient is dewy lasher fronds. You'll find them around Lake Al'Ameth directly south of here, or Wellspring Lake and its river to the northwest.

In addition, I'll need an empty vial and some spring water. Both can be bought here in town, or traded for.
99050-accept.title: The Great Tree Provides

99050-complete.name: Byancie
99050-complete.text:
Thank you for your help. Please, accept this to help with the costs of the vial and water.

Now, to make the salve. It should only take a moment.
99050-complete.title: The Great Tree Provides

99050-progress.name: Byancie
99050-progress.text: Do you have the ingredients? I fear Eralya may not have long.
99050-progress.title: The Great Tree Provides

99051-accept.name: Orgnil Soulscar
99051-accept.text:
It wouldn't be the first time those snakes bothered us. They need to be taught that their presence is not tolerated here.

Find where their scouts are setting up camp and slaughter them. Bring me back their fins as proof. We need to act fast to make sure they understand.
99051-accept.title: Threat from Below

99051-complete.name: Orgnil Soulscar
99051-complete.text: Hopefully that sends them packing back to the north. I'll have some grunts keep an eye out for any stragglers or funny business.
99051-complete.title: Threat from Below

99051-progress.name: Orgnil Soulscar
99051-progress.text: Hopefully those snake scum aren't giving you trouble?
99051-progress.title: Threat from Below

99052-accept.name: Orgnil Soulscar
99052-accept.text:
One of my scouts has reported a sea giant followed those naga down here. Not sure if they brought him intentionally or what, but he's dangerous in any case.

It's a young one, but it could still rip an orc in half in a heartbeat if they were caught off guard. I need him gone. But I'd suggest you find some help to deal with it.
99052-accept.title: Threat from Below

99052-complete.name: Orgnil Soulscar
99052-complete.text:
Ha! I could hear his body fall from here!

Be proud of your kill today, not many can claim they survived a fight with a sea giant.
99052-complete.title: Threat from Below

99073-accept.name: Byancie
99073-accept.text:
The salve is ready. Take it to Eralya swiftly.

I do not know if it will truly cure her. The rot festers quickly, and grows in strength as it spreads.

It will, if nothing else, ease her suffering. And that is still worth your haste.
99073-accept.title: Easing Suffering

99073-complete.name: Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow
99073-complete.text: <Eralya's breath calms quickly as you help her ingest the salve. She may not survive, but is at relative peace.>
99073-complete.title: Easing Suffering

99073-progress.name: Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow
99073-progress.text: <Eralya has stopped responding verbally. Only a weak, gurgled exhale confirms life.>
99073-progress.title: Easing Suffering

99079-accept.name: Brave Wildrunner
99079-accept.text:
The Longwalkers are our people's most trusted scouts. Though their loyalty lies with the High Chieftain alone, young Baine at times seeks their aid.

This is one such time. Longwalker Malah was dispatched near our borders to the east and did not return last night after three days. When this occurs, it is our duty to confirm their safety.

I must ensure the village remains safe. Prove yourself, and seek Malah out. You will know her by her headband and feathered staff, emblematic of the Longwalkers.
99079-accept.title: Longwalker Malah

99079-complete.name: Malah Longwind
99079-complete.text: It is clear that Malah did not die naturally. Arrows cover her back and the ground nearby.
99079-complete.title: Longwalker Malah

99080-accept.name: Baine Bloodhoof
99080-accept.text:
Hear my words well: we will not yield a single blade of grass to the centaur.

Go to their camp now, before they have rested and have a chance to ride to our village. Slaughter them all. Ensure none escape to the Barrens to rally others to their aid.

If you find the leader of this would-be raiding party, bring me his head so that it may serve as a warning to others who dare tread on our ancestral homeland.
99080-accept.title: Drive Them Out

99080-complete.name: Baine Bloodhoof
99080-complete.text:
You are covered in centaur blood. Remember this feeling. It is an honor unlike any other among our people.

I could hear the moment the last fell, and their thunderous stampede echoed no longer. Well done!

Today marks a great victory for our village, and a security our young ones need now more than ever. You have my deepest thanks, young $c.
99080-complete.title: Drive Them Out

99081-accept.name: Malah Longwind
99081-accept.text:
You can see what appears to be a new centaur camp in the direction the arrows in Malah's back would have come from. There is a stir of activity, suggesting a small raiding party has made its way into Mulgore.

The Longwalker has a report in her still-clenched hand. Brave Wildrunner will want to know of Malah's fate--and her killers.
99081-accept.title: Grim Tidings

99081-complete.name: Brave Wildrunner
99081-complete.text: This is most dire news indeed. We must inform Baine at once!
99081-complete.title: Grim Tidings

99082-accept.name: Baine Bloodhoof
99082-accept.text:
Your bravery defending your people demands recognition. Journey to Thunder Bluff to the northwest, our mighty city whose shadow grants us shade in the warmer months, and seek audience with my father.

It was he who led the charge with the young Warchief Thrall to reclaim these plains and drive the centaur away for good. As High Chieftain, he will reward you generously for your part in ensuring his own bravery is honored.

You must take a lift to reach the High Chieftain, who sits on the central rise.
99082-accept.title: The High Chieftain

99082-complete.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
99082-complete.text:
The Galak centaur dare show themselves in Mulgore?!

You have brought pride to your ancestors by driving them out. Perhaps that will remind them of the pain that awaits them should they do so again!

Please accept this gift in honor of this. May it serve you well as you venture out into the Earth Mother's kingdom, to the far reaches of this world.
99082-complete.title: The High Chieftain

99101-accept.name: Brave Wildrunner
99101-accept.text:
Baine Bloodhoof leads our village. He must know of this incursion at once.

Bring him Longwalker Malah's report. You will find him at the center of town.

Quickly, now. There is no time to waste!
99101-accept.title: Our Ancient Enemy

99101-complete.name: Baine Bloodhoof
99101-complete.text:
<Baine reads the report, his gaze darkening.>

This will not stand. Thank you for delivering it to me, $N.
99101-complete.title: Our Ancient Enemy

99101-progress.name: Baine Bloodhoof
99101-progress.text: What is it you bring me, $c?
99101-progress.title: Our Ancient Enemy

99108-accept.name: Krang Stonehoof
99108-accept.text:
Hail, young $c. Though you are not a warrior and I cannot teach you that path, that does not mean you would not benefit from my tutelage.

Before you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or bow. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.

Will you enter our space, and learn our ways for yourself? You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.
99108-accept.title: Sparring Match

99108-complete.name: Krang Stonehoof
99108-complete.text:
You honor me with your abilities, $c. Perhaps the new generation has hope yet.

Take these to tend to your wounds, for many more battles await you in this harsh world.
99108-complete.title: Sparring Match

99123-accept.name: Pal'juh
99123-accept.text:
I decided to do a bit of scouting in the crag on my own. Unfortunately my magic ran out at the wrong time and I've been stuck hiding here since.

If you could help me escape, I would appreciate it.
99123-accept.title: Lost in the Shadows

99123-complete.name: Master Vornal
99123-complete.text:
Ah, Pal'juh got herself in trouble again, did she?

Hopefully she learns her lesson about going alone this time. Thank you for helping her. She's a promising hunter, just tends to act more like a raptor than a tiger.
99123-complete.title: Lost in the Shadows

99127-accept.name: Jason Mathers
99127-accept.text:
The fish just ain't biting today, and there's something wrong going on with them. It's not just empty hooks. I haven't seen a single minnow up in the water at all.

Lee here set up some traps overnight, go check to see if we've at least got some stock there. If you find anything weird, make sure to show me.
99127-accept.title: A Net Disaster

99127-complete.name: Jason Mathers
99127-complete.text: All the traps are like this? Seems our new neighboring nuisances are causing more destruction than we were aware of. I'll go broke if we don't do something about it.
99127-complete.title: A Net Disaster

99128-accept.name: Jason Mathers
99128-accept.text:
This can only be the work of those murlocs on the other side of the lake. They're disgusting little things, with a vicious temper and teeth to match. 

If we let this continue, there won't be any fish to speak of anywhere in this lake. If you could clear them out a bit, it would help me a ton.
99128-accept.title: Slimy Menace

99128-complete.name: Jason Mathers
99128-complete.text: I can hear their warbling from here, it'll be in my nightmares. Well, that should slow them down--although I have no doubt that they'll make up those numbers quickly.
99128-complete.title: Slimy Menace

99129-accept.name: Jason Mathers
99129-accept.text:
Remy mentioned murlocs the other day... I'm pretty sure he hates the little buggers as much as I do. 

He might have some ideas on how to keep them away from my fish in the future. I'd like to ask you to go chat with him and see if there's anything he can think of.
99129-accept.title: A Man About a Murloc

99129-complete.name: Remy "Two Times"
99129-complete.text:
I've been warning the guards about the murlocs. They won't listen.

I have a few ideas on how to get back at those critters. I'll need your help getting what I need for it though.
99129-complete.title: A Man About a Murloc

99130-accept.name: Remy "Two Times"
99130-accept.text:
I've got a few ideas on how to deal with murlocs. And one of those also helps some others in the process.

There's a weed often found on farms in the area called duskweed, and in large quantities the petals are toxic to most animals. If we make some murloc bait with the plant, hopefully that can train those creatures to stay away.

And some farmers get their fields cleared in the process. Truly a win-win... truly a win-win.
99130-accept.title: An Enticing Offer

99130-complete.name: Remy "Two Times"
99130-complete.text:
Give me just a minute...

It's pretty simple bait, but as long as nobody's pet gets into it, it should be safe. Just tell Jason not to eat any of it.
99130-complete.title: An Enticing Offer

99131-accept.name: Remy "Two Times"
99131-accept.text:
Tell Mathers he can come pick up the bait later today. I'll give him the rundown on the proper usage.

Hopefully he'll be able to sell his fish again soon. And we'll have less murlocs in this world.
99131-accept.title: Baited for Success

99131-complete.name: Jason Mathers
99131-complete.text: Poisoned bait? As long as the fish aren't going to eat it, that should work. I'll visit Remy later to pick it up.
99131-complete.title: Baited for Success

99134-accept.name: Executor Zygand
99134-accept.text:
You are not a member of the Deathguard, and therefore have yet to disappoint me.

As a reward for your lack of incompetence, you shall be rewarded with punishing those that have demonstrated such talents in excess.

Swiftly now--$N, is it?--or I shall add your name to my ledger for someone else's reward.
99134-accept.title: Discipline

99134-complete.name: Executor Zygand
99134-complete.text:
There are precious few delights afforded to us in death. Thankfully, pain is chief among them.

You please me this day, and therefore you please the Dark Lady. Perhaps you can be of further use.
99134-complete.title: Discipline

99141-accept.name: Executor Zygand
99141-accept.text:
Make no mistake, $c--the Dark Lady demands the perfect execution of her will. As an Executor, it is my duty to see that this happens.

Reports from several of my Deathguards are overdue. Needless to say, my patience has run out. Obtain their reports and bring them to me in the Dark Lady's name.

You will find Deathguard Dillinger just west of here, by the graveyard. Deathguard Kristof is stationed at the waystation to the east. And check on the abomination Gordo; he wanders west near Stillwater Pond.
99141-accept.title: Patience

99141-complete.name: Executor Zygand
99141-complete.text:
I should have known better than to think an abomination could write anything of use. Let us keep that lapse of judgment between us.

You have pleased me, and therefore pleased the Dark Lady. Perhaps there is hope for you.
99141-complete.title: Patience

99141-progress.name: Executor Zygand
99141-progress.text: You'd best have those reports in hand, or get out of my face.
99141-progress.title: Patience

99142-accept.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
99142-accept.text:
If you're heading east, towards the Balnir Farmstead, I have more you might do for me. Good help is ever so hard to find these days, as your run-in with Gordo illuminates ever so clearly.

As I acquire doom weed I perform some minor alchemical alterations and replant them on that farmstead to cultivate my ultimate creation. I call it tomb weed, and it shall be the herald of my glorious destiny.

Do keep an eye on the Scourge in the area while you're there. They seem... drawn... to the weed. Curious.
99142-accept.title: Tomb Weed

99142-complete.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
99142-complete.text:
Most glorious indeed!

<Junior Apothecary Holland inspects the weeds.>

Hmm, I had hoped they would have matured a bit more violently. Nevertheless, progress is progress!

A great many will die as a result of your actions this day. You should be proud.
99142-complete.title: Tomb Weed

99142-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
99142-progress.text: More interruptions! Wait, it's you. Were you able to recover the tomb weed?
99142-progress.title: Tomb Weed

99143-accept.name: Lee Brown
99143-accept.text:
Those fish men must think like actual fish, right? Which means anything they like, fish will like!

If you rummage through some of their junk and return to me with anything that seems like it would make good bait, I'll reward you.
99143-accept.title: Bottles and Baubles

99143-complete.name: Lee Brown
99143-complete.text:
An interesting collection. These should work well enough!

Here's some of my own older supplies. It should help anyone trying to get their footing in fishing.
99143-complete.title: Bottles and Baubles

99143-progress.name: Lee Brown
99143-progress.text: What did you find? Anything interesting?
99143-progress.title: Bottles and Baubles

99144-accept.name: Bareth Dawnstone
99144-accept.text:
Light bless you for finding me. I was on my way from Bandarion Keep to deliver a message to Shari Stilwell in Brill when these monsters captured me. They wield the Light with a hatred in their hearts that makes what's left of my blood seethe. It goes against all I meditate for... all I strive to protect!

<Bareth Dawnstone steadies himself.>

I know some still take issue with my kind, but I assure you our intentions are pure. If you would aid me in escaping this place, I would be forever grateful.
99144-accept.title: Seeking Refuge

99144-complete.name: Shari Stilwell
99144-complete.text:
Blessings upon you for aiding Dawnstone. Our order is still taking root here and $n would be devastating to lose one so promising before his time.

Please accept this as a token of our thanks. Should you ever take an interest in our ways, our monastery Bandarion Keep lies on the bluffs northwest of the Solliden Farmstead. We welcome all who seek guidance in the Light.
99144-complete.title: Seeking Refuge

99152-accept.name: Hilda the Breaker
99152-accept.text:
While the Tarnished in Shadowvale to the southwest are definitely a problem, we cannot allow the cellars below the town to fester into a full-blown Scourge uprising on Bandarion Keep.

I need to get these trainees up to snuff in case that happens. You, however, are going to receive what I like to call a crash course.

Travel beneath Shadowvale and retrieve some of their wretched bones so we can study them further. I need ones that still retain some of the initial reanimation magic--that's glowing ones.
99152-accept.title: As Above, So Below

99152-complete.name: Hilda the Breaker
99152-complete.text:
Well done, recruit. We might just make something out of you yet.

With these bones we may be able to better understand how such a threat was able to go unnoticed for so long.
99152-complete.title: As Above, So Below

99152-progress.name: Hilda the Breaker
99152-progress.text: You'd best not be returning empty-handed. I either need the bones I asked for, or your body on a stretcher to confirm you at least gave it your all trying to get them.
99152-progress.title: As Above, So Below

99153-accept.name: Ephram Barbaro
99153-accept.text:
Oi, you! Word travels quickly among our ranks. I heard about the work you did with the cultists around the remnants of the battle with Naxxramas.

Problem is, one of them cultists got away with a piece of the focusing crystal. Seems to still have some juice in it. Best guess we have is it's somewhere beneath Shadowvale. It's either raising 'em or making 'em stronger, and you don't want either one.

Find that crystal before this gets out of hand.
99153-accept.title: The One That Got Away

99153-complete.name: Ephram Barbaro
99153-complete.text: Well done--and quick, too! Now onto my favorite part...
99153-complete.title: The One That Got Away

99153-progress.name: Ephram Barbaro
99153-progress.text: Did you find the damned thing?
99153-progress.title: The One That Got Away

99156-accept.name: Deathguard Linnea
99156-accept.text:
Damn it all! A new report came in while you were on patrol. There has been a sighting of a rogue abomination wandering Eastern Tirisfal Glades, near Venomweb Vale.

Something is wrong. Abominations don't just slip through the Bulwark unnoticed.

Keep this matter on a strictly need-to-know basis. That said, such a creature will not fall easily; you will need allies if you wish to be more than its next meal.

See this through, and you will be duly rewarded. Bring me its heart as proof of the deed.
99156-accept.title: Rear Guard Patrol

99156-complete.name: Deathguard Linnea
99156-complete.text:
You are a testament to the cunning and coordination that all Forsaken possess--something the mindless Scourge will never have.

Please accept this as thanks for your efforts, as promised.
99156-complete.title: Rear Guard Patrol

99156-progress.name: Deathguard Linnea
99156-progress.text: Have you dealt with our little problem?
99156-progress.title: Rear Guard Patrol

99158-accept.name: Maxan Anvol
99158-accept.text:
There's a priest out in the mountains that belongs to an organization called the Argent Dawn. They're a holy group that is dedicated to finding and destroying the unholy and unnatural.

Father Gavin though, he's mostly the type that seeks to help and heal everyone rather than grab a weapon. He's fixed up an old building to serve as a rest spot for travelers and called it Misty Pine Refuge. I've got a shipment of holy candles that I need to get him. Could you bring them to him if your going that way?
99158-accept.title: Dawn in the Mountains

99158-complete.name: Father Gavin
99158-complete.text:
Ah. Candles from Ironforge. 

While I am mostly able to live independently in my hermitage, there are a few key things that I appreciate from the city and the pious.
99158-complete.title: Dawn in the Mountains

99158-progress.name: Father Gavin
99158-progress.text: Why did the Light guide you here today?
99158-progress.title: Dawn in the Mountains

99159-accept.name: Father Gavin
99159-accept.text:
My hearth is open to warm any soul, but I'd like to ask you to help me if you could.

I simply need more firewood. It is something I would normally do myself, but I have been preoccupied by other tasks.
99159-accept.title: Finding Warmth

99159-complete.name: Father Gavin
99159-complete.text:
Ah, perfect. These will do--any that are too wet to use right now I will leave to dry.

Now, if you're willing, I have more tasks I could use help with.
99159-complete.title: Finding Warmth

99159-progress.name: Father Gavin
99159-progress.text: Light guide you on your tasks.
99159-progress.title: Finding Warmth

99160-accept.name: Father Gavin
99160-accept.text:
You may have noticed the elementals nearby. A shelf of rock and ice fell from the mountain peaks a few days ago and riled them up.

These frozen mountains are already treacherous for the average dwarf or human without the elements taking form. I am not one for fighting anymore--so any of the spirits you can kill would help make the road safer.
99160-accept.title: Rime's Wrath

99160-complete.name: Father Gavin
99160-complete.text: I wish we could have simply placated them. Unfortunately it was beyond my knowledge and they were too dangerous to leave unchecked.
99160-complete.title: Rime's Wrath

99161-accept.name: Father Gavin
99161-accept.text:
I noticed that the first elemental that appeared after the rockslide was larger than its peers. And from what I can tell, it has been the source of occasionally weather changes and other minor slides.

I've been calling it 'Avala', if you could kill it and retrieve the core as proof, I will reward you.
99161-accept.title: Rime's Wrath

99161-complete.name: Father Gavin
99161-complete.text: Light bless you, $c. Your efforts make this area much safer and hopefully will prevent unnecessary deaths.
99161-complete.title: Rime's Wrath

99162-accept.name: Father Gavin
99162-accept.text:
Even mountaineers from Ironforge have to keep their wits about them when traversing through the peaks of Dun Morogh. Falling snow and ice often spells the end of some more novice members' lives.

After a slide, I usually try to find any sign of survivors or victims--while praying to the Light that there's nothing to be found. But with the elements acting up, I've held off wandering too far. If you could look for some lost mountaineers and bring me their rifles, I will return them to Ironforge.
99162-accept.title: Treacherous Cold

99162-complete.name: Father Gavin
99162-complete.text: The mountaineers engrave their names on the stock of their rifles. It helps identify them should something happen. I'll send these back to Ironforge--there someone will pass them on to any family.
99162-complete.title: Treacherous Cold

99196-progress.name: Oura Stormspinner
99196-progress.text:
The Windshapers are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.

A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Windshapers for your generosity. 

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
99196-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

99260-accept.name: Fillion Flamebreeze
99260-accept.text:
I was tasked to retrieve important data on the flow of elemental energy from the Overlook Standing Stones. That data is vital to our plans to safely travel between Skywall and Azeroth. Without that data to aid in our calculations, our attempts to steer our skycutter ships through the elemental plane will fail.

The data is likely lost at this point, and I'm in no state to attempt to gather it again. I told the Supreme Magister of your role in saving me, and he wishes to speak with you again.
99260-accept.title: Fillion's Mission

99260-complete.name: Elaadrin Evengale
99260-complete.text:
Thank you for saving Fillion, $N. I'm sure he told you how vital the data he was sent to retrieve is.

Without that data, our prospects for opening safe lanes of travel to Azeroth is at serious jeopardy. Our spies tell us that the Windshapers have themselves procured the means to traverse the planes, and no doubt wish to jealously guard this secret.

As ever, their own dogmatic hubris take precedence over the good of our people. They are little better than the Al'Aketh.
99260-complete.title: Fillion's Mission

997-accept.name: Syral Bladeleaf
997-accept.text:
Are you heading to the south?  To Lake Al'Ameth?  If so, then I have a task I might ask of you...

My colleague Denalan has a camp along the eastern end of the lake, where he is studying and experimenting on the plant life of Teldrassil.  He requested a package of rare earths from Darnassus and it was late, only recently arriving here in Dolanaar.

Can you take the package to him?
997-accept.title: Denalan's Earth

997-complete.name: Denalan
997-complete.text: Ah, it's here!  I have waited for this rare earth for quite some time.  I hope it's still fresh...$B$BThank you for bringing it to me, $N.  You are a $r who is generous with $ghis:her; time.
997-complete.title: Denalan's Earth
